score.description: The provider's score for this side, verbatim. A string because the provider sends one: a set score, a map score and a run total are not all integers. Omitted when no live-score frame carries a score.

record.description: The provider's season record for this side, for example 12-4. Omitted when the provider sent none.

GameTrade.description: One fill in a game, as the game page's activity list shows it.

id.description: Stable fill identity: {transaction_hash}:{token_id}:{wallet}:{shares}. Deduplicate on it across polls.

traded_at.description: When the fill happened, to the second.

side.description: The provider's side of the fill.

outcome.description: The traded outcome's label; null when the provider named none.

outcome_index.description: 0 for the first (Yes) outcome token, 1 for the second (No); null when the provider did not say.

point.description: The signed handicap the fill's side carries on a spread line, for example -1.5 or 1.5; null off spreads.

display_name.description: The name the site shows: the 0xinsider username, else the provider's name or pseudonym, else the shortened address.

grade.description: The trader's grade today; null for an ungraded or untracked wallet.

id.description: The market's v1 id, mkt_ plus the condition_id.

condition_id.description: The raw provider condition_id.

line_label.description: The market's name within the game, for example Draw, O/U 2.5, First to Score: CD Guadalajara, Game 2: Any Player Quadra Kill.

GameMarketPriceCompetitor.description: One competitor-bound provider moneyline price. No YES/NO inference is required.

provider_id.description: The provider competitor id when identity is available.

price_provenance.description: Which provider price observation supplies this leg.

GameMarketPriceBindingProvenance.description: How the existing sports-board writer bound prices to competitors.

GameMarketPricePaired.description: A validated provider moneyline pair bound to the two competitors.

competitor_a_is_yes.description: Whether competitor A is the provider YES leg.

GameMarketPriceIncomplete.description: The provider moneyline pair is incomplete; no numeric pair is invented.

competitor_a_is_yes.description: Whether competitor A is the provider YES leg.

competitor_a_provider_id.description: The provider competitor id when identity is available.

competitor_b_provider_id.description: The provider competitor id when identity is available.

GameMarketPriceInvalid.description: The provider moneyline pair is invalid; no numeric pair is invented.

competitor_a_is_yes.description: Whether competitor A is the provider YES leg.

competitor_a_provider_id.description: The provider competitor id when identity is available.

competitor_b_provider_id.description: The provider competitor id when identity is available.

GameMarketPrices.description: Provider-owned moneyline state with the observation clock that can be compared with game freshness.

observed_at.description: Board cache vintage for Gamma or the older CLOB leg clock. Null when no reliable clock is available; never a Gamma-authored timestamp.

observation_source.description: The clock used for observed_at. board_snapshot is this service’s cache observation, not a provider source timestamp.

GameMarket.description: One Polymarket market linked to this game.

id.description: The mkt_-prefixed market id every other V1 response uses.

condition_id.description: The raw provider condition id.

slug.description: The provider's market slug. Omitted when the provider sent none.

sports_market_type.description: The provider's own market type, for example moneyline or spread. Omitted when the provider sent none. Not an enum: the provider owns this vocabulary and adds to it.

side.description: Which side of the game this market's YES leg pays. Soccer 1X2 legs are explicitly classified as home, draw or away by the provider projection. draw is a real value, not a competitor. Omitted when the provider projection cannot classify the leg, which is not the same as other.

outcome_yes.description: The provider's label for the YES outcome. Omitted when the provider sent none.

outcome_no.description: The provider's label for the NO outcome. Omitted when the provider sent none.

outcome_token_ids.description: Polymarket CLOB token ids in the provider's own outcome-index order. Omitted when the provider has published none for this market.

prices.description: Default provider moneyline state. Omitted when this market has no classified moneyline projection; incomplete and invalid projections remain explicit.

liquidity.description: Polymarket's reported liquidity for this market. Omitted when the provider read carried none, and on a finished game read from its stored record; never 0 in place of a missing figure.

GameMarketLiquidity.description: One market's liquidity as Polymarket reports it (Gamma liquidityNum), verbatim. Polymarket documents it only as reported market liquidity, with no unit. It describes the market's resting order book, not traded volume.

value.description: The provider's figure at full precision.

source.description: Always gamma: the Polymarket Gamma API.

observed_at.description: When 0xinsider read the sports board body this figure came from, never a provider-authored timestamp. Omitted when that read has no clock.

GameFreshness.description: How current this game's facts are. Independent per source: the board half that produced the game, and the live-score frame that produced its scores.

source.description: What produced this game: live or upcoming, the board half that carried it, or stored, the stored record of a finished game that has left the board (GET /api/v1/games/{event_slug}, and GET /api/v1/games with a finished status).

source_status.description: Whether that half returned a truthful source body for this read.

source_availability.description: Whether that half had a source body at all. not_applicable means the sport has no configured source for that half.

source_freshness.description: Freshness of the cached source body, never inferred from the response clock or the row count. not_applicable for a stored game, whose record is final.

source_observed_at.description: The source body's data vintage. Omitted when the read has no vintage anchor, which is not age zero. For a stored game, the later of its last live-score write and its last leg settlement.

source_age_seconds.description: Age of source_observed_at in seconds, capped at 600. Omitted past the cap or with no anchor.

delayed.description: Whether a reader should be told these rows are behind. This applies the half's own servable-age bar (15 s live, 120 s upcoming), which is not the same as source_freshness: a live board whose scores are seconds old reads stale for about half of every publish cycle and is not delayed.

scores_observed_at.description: When this game's live-score frame was observed. Omitted when there is no frame.

scores_source_at.description: The provider's own frame clock. Omitted when the frame carries none.

GameCoverage.description: What this game's read actually supplied, so a client branches on coverage instead of on a missing key.

scores.description: available when a live-score frame supplied a score for this game. A game no live-score feed has reported yet, as most scheduled games are, reads unavailable.

competitors.description: provider_ids when every side carries a provider id, labels when only the provider's names identify them, unavailable when neither exists. Do not join on names when this reads labels.

schedule.description: available when the provider supplied a kickoff.

GamesCoverage.description: What this deployment covers, published with every page so a client never has to guess whether an empty list means no games or no coverage.

leagues.description: League tags served, sorted. EuroLeague is euroleague, NCAA men's college basketball cbb and NCAA women's college basketball cwbb, all under the Basketball sport bucket.

sources_unavailable.description: Scopes whose source half was unavailable for this read, as <sport>:<half>. Empty means every scope answered.

request_id.description: Unique request ID (req_ prefix). The same value as the X-Request-Id response header, the request's usage accounting row and its log lines.

cache_age_s.description: Cache age in seconds. Omitted when the response was not cached, and also when it was cached but its age cannot be established (an entry stored before its cache carried a computed instant). Never a placeholder: an unknown age is reported as no value rather than as the cache TTL.

cost.description: Advisory request weight (relative compute cost). 1 for simple reads; higher for heavier endpoints. Not a credit/price.

ranking_generation.description: Committed PostgreSQL-owned leaderboard generation for the returned rows and cursor. Present on GET /api/v1/leaderboard; omitted on endpoints that do not read this ranking.

ranking_as_of.description: Authoritative RFC3339 timestamp from cache_generations.updated_at for ranking_generation. It is read in the same repeatable-read snapshot as the leaderboard rows and is not request time, cache write time, or row insertion order.

directional_source.description: Directional evidence provenance for Edge Hunter signals collections. The default board carries this provenance in data.directional_source and omits this optional meta field.

ranking_source.description: Ranking evidence provenance for Edge Hunter signals collections. The default board carries this clock/provenance in data.ranking_source and omits this optional meta field.

category_skill_source.description: Whole filtered snapshot category-evidence status before pagination. Operational live always remains partial source coverage.

category_skill_model_operationally_degra.description: Whole-model operational readiness captured with the category model snapshot. Present on category-enriched responses even when the filtered signal list is empty. When true, category_skill_source is degraded and Edge Hunter signals uses the shorter degraded cache TTL.

category_skill_base_payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the funded signal membership/order/rank/cursor vector immediately before category-skill enrichment. Edge Hunter signals view only.

category_skill_enriched_base_payload_has.description: Independent SHA-256 recomputation over the same base fields immediately after category-skill enrichment. Equality with category_skill_base_payload_hash proves category-skill enrichment did not change funded inputs. Edge Hunter signals view only.

api_base_url.description: Canonical API origin for public V1 requests.

authentication.const: Bearer API key required for data endpoints; discovery (/api/v1), health, coverage (/api/v1/coverage, and its deprecated alias /api/v1/platforms), the Pick of the Day commitment ledger (/api/v1/pick-of-the-day/ledger), and the MCP handshake (initialize, ping, tools/list on /api/v1/mcp) are public. A 401 carries WWW-Authenticate with the resource_metadata URL.

protected_resource_metadata_url.description: RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata for the API origin: the document every V1 401 names in its WWW-Authenticate challenge (resource, bearer_methods_supported, resource_documentation). The remote MCP server has its own document at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/v1/mcp.

authenticated_routes.description: The complete authenticated route index: one entry per authenticated route this spec documents, in "<METHOD> <path>" form, not a representative subset. GET /api/v1 is the unauthenticated entrypoint an agent hits first, so it hands back the whole authenticated surface rather than a sample the caller would have to guess around. The example on GET /api/v1 is abridged for readability -- the live response returns all of them. Kept in lockstep with this spec by review: it is a hand-maintained const in backend/src/api_v1/discovery.rs and no automated check compares the two, so treat this spec as authoritative if they ever disagree.

LargeTradeInsertedV2Data.description: `large_trade_inserted_v2` data (Pro and Max): one large trade, with the trade itself. The three amounts are decimal strings that keep the stored precision: parse them with a decimal library when the exact value matters. The endpoint's `trade_filters` decide which trades it receives.

event_id.description: Stable identity of this trade's event. It equals the envelope `id`, and the `id` of the same event on `GET /api/v1/events/feed/since`.

whale_alert_id.description: Numeric id of the trade. `GET /api/v1/large-trades/{id}` accepts it.

condition_id.description: Polymarket condition id of the market.

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that made the trade.

grade.description: The wallet's grade when the event was published; `null` when it has none.

size_usd.description: USD notional of the trade; decimal string.

price.description: Price paid per share; decimal string.

outcome_index.description: Polymarket's index of the outcome traded.

traded_at.description: When the trade filled on Polymarket. The envelope's `created_at` is this instant.

LargeTradesInsertedData.description: `large_trades_inserted` data (Pro and Max): new large trades were ingested. It carries a count and no trade; subscribe to `large_trade_inserted_v2` for the trade itself. The deprecated spelling `whale_trades_inserted` delivers the same object until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

count.description: Large trades the producing batch admitted.

LiveSportsScoreEntry.description: One side's score line inside a `live_sports_updated` pulse.

team.description: Team name, ordered for the league (away first where the league reads that way).

score.description: This side's score as the provider sends it.

map_score.description: Esports series only: this side's current-map score. Absent on other sports.

LiveSportsUpdatedData.description: `live_sports_updated` data: one bounded pulse for one live game. A pulse fires when a material field moved since this game's previous delivered pulse (`scores`, `status`, `period`, `live`, `ended`), at most once per game per 20 seconds. A `live` or `ended` transition is exempt from that interval, and the game clock alone never fires a pulse. Suppressed frames are folded into the next pulse's `changed`, and its body carries the current state.

event_slug.description: The Polymarket event slug this game trades under.

game_id.description: Provider game id, or `null` when the frame carried none.

version.description: Durable per-game pulse ordinal, increasing by one per delivered pulse. Deliveries are not ordered, so drop a pulse whose version you already saw.

changed.description: Material fields that moved since this game's previous delivered pulse.

observed_at.description: Provider frame time, or `null` when the frame carried none. Never replaced with a local clock.

status.description: Provider status text, or `null`.

clock.description: Game clock, or `null`. Not a material field: it never fires a pulse on its own.

live.description: Provider live flag, or `null` when the frame carried none.

ended.description: Whether the provider has marked this game final.

scores.description: Per-side scores, one line per team.

series_format.description: Esports `BoN` series token, or `null` on every other sport.

snapshot_url.description: Public game page. Re-read it after a gap instead of replaying pulses.

TraderSyncedData.description: `trader_synced` data: a tracked wallet finished a sync pass and has a fresh grade. The deprecated spelling `whale_trader_synced` delivers the same object until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

WalletGradeChangedData.description: `wallet_grade_changed` data (Pro and Max): a tracked wallet's grade moved on a re-grade.

old_grade.description: The grade before the move. Never equal to `new_grade`.

skill_index.description: Cohort skill index that drove the grade, 0 to 1.

final_score.description: Final 0 to 100 score banded into the new grade.

date.description: The ranking date of the re-grade.

SuspiciousTradeFlaggedData.description: `suspicious_trade_flagged` data (Pro and Max): a trade's suspicion score crossed the flag threshold for the first time. The deprecated spelling `insider_radar_flag_raised` delivers the same object until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

trade_id.description: Numeric id of the flagged trade, a JSON number. It is the `id` that `GET /api/v1/large-trades/{id}` accepts.

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that made the trade.

condition_id.description: Polymarket condition id of the market.

suspicion_score.description: The suspicion score, 0 to 100, that crossed the threshold.

track.description: The scoring track that raised the flag.

side.description: Outcome side the flagged fill took.

size.description: Share count of the flagged fill.

price.description: Fill price of the flagged trade.

SharpMoneyFlowDetectedData.description: `sharp_money_flow_detected` data (Pro and Max): ranked-trader net flow on a market crossed the threshold. The deprecated spelling `smart_money_flow_detected` delivers the same object until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

condition_id.description: Polymarket condition id of the market.

net_flow_usd.description: Signed ranked-trader net flow in USD over `window`: positive is net into YES, negative net into NO.

abs_net_flow_usd.description: Absolute value of `net_flow_usd`, the magnitude compared with the threshold.

grade_floor.description: Minimum trader grade included in the flow.

whale_trade_count.description: Ranked-trader large fills that make up the flow.

window.description: Window the flow was aggregated over, for example `24h`.

ExportJobReadyData.description: `export_job_ready` data: the owner's asynchronous export can be downloaded. Download authorization stays on the status and download routes.

ExportJobFailedData.description: `export_job_failed` data: the owner's asynchronous export reached a terminal failure.

ExportJobExpiredData.description: `export_job_expired` data: the owner's ready export passed retention.

ExportJobCancelledData.description: `export_job_cancelled` data: the owner's export stopped because its owner cancelled it.

request_id.description: Unique request ID (req_ prefix). The same value as the X-Request-Id response header, the request's usage accounting row and its log lines.

cache_age_s.description: Cache age in seconds; the key is absent when the response was not cached.

reason.description: Explains that local replay completeness can vary by market and time window.

id.description: Opaque event identity: the ef_-encoded whale_alerts.id, stable across cursor formats. Deduplicate on this, never on cursor or sequence.

cursor.description: Cursor positioned at this event: its (inserted_xid, id) commit-order position. Store the page's next_cursor to continue; this one resumes from exactly this event.

sequence.description: whale_alerts.id of the event. Not monotonic across a replay: events arrive in commit order, so a lower id can follow a higher one when its write finished later. Order and resume by cursor, deduplicate by id.

payload.description: What the event announces. Every field is present on every event; a field added later is additive, so a client tolerates keys it does not know.

count.description: Whale trades this event announces. One event is minted per stored whale trade, so this is 1.

whale_alert_id.description: The raw whale_alerts.id of the trade, the same number as sequence. GET /api/v1/whale-trades/{id} accepts it and returns the trade with its wallet, grade, size, price and market.

condition_id.description: The Polymarket condition id of the market the trade was in.

trader_id.description: 0xinsider's numeric id for the wallet's trader row. It is not the trd_ id, which is derived from the address; read the address and grade from the whale trade.

trade.description: Present only with expand=trade: the base trade fields for this row, read at request time from one query per page. GET /api/v1/large-trades/{id} adds counterparty_analysis; replay does not include it. traded_at, side, size_usd, price, outcome, token_id, recorded_signal_score and trader.grade_at_trade with its status are the row's event-time facts; trader.grade, trader.username, signal_score, suspicion_score, suspicion_track and market title/slug/category are enrichment that can move after the event. null when that route would answer 404 for the row (its trader or market is not synced yet).

request_id.description: Unique request ID (req_ prefix). The same value as the X-Request-Id response header, the request's usage accounting row and its log lines.

cost.description: Advisory request weight (relative compute cost). 1 for simple reads; higher for heavier endpoints. Not a credit/price.

from_cursor.description: The request cursor in canonical form (an id-only cursor is re-encoded), or the zero position when omitted.

to_cursor.description: Identical to next_cursor. After a full page, the cursor of the last event; after a page that is not full, the commit horizon itself, since every row below it, matching or not, has been examined. An empty page therefore still advances.

from_sequence.description: whale_alerts.id component of the request cursor (0 when omitted).

to_sequence.description: whale_alerts.id of the last event on this page, or from_sequence when the page is empty. Can sit below the position next_cursor encodes after a page that is not full.

ordering.description: Events are ordered by the position at which their write became visible (whale_alerts.inserted_xid), then by whale_alerts.id, and a page is bounded by the oldest write transaction still open when it was read. Before 2026-09-22 this read whale_alerts_id_asc; that order could skip a late-committing lower id (#16180).

pending_beyond_horizon.description: True when committed whale-trade rows newer than this page's commit-visibility horizon exist. They are held until every older write transaction has finished and are served on a later request, so a caught_up page with this true is not the end of the stream: poll again. A long open write transaction on the database (a single-transaction backfill) is what keeps this true for more than a few seconds.

filters.description: The effective filter set this page ran with and next_cursor is bound to. Absent on an unfiltered walk.

condition_id.description: The raw provider condition id after mkt_ is stripped.

expand.description: The expansions applied to every event on this page; empty when none.

status.description: complete: the page carries every durable event matching the filters after the cursor below the commit horizon, up to limit. caught_up: nothing matching after the cursor is visible below the horizon; read pending_beyond_horizon to tell an idle stream from held rows, and note next_cursor has still advanced to the horizon.

TrustSource.description: Source metadata for a trust-critical value. Providers and DB/read models own business truth; clients should not infer missing provider facts from titles, slugs, zeros, or empty arrays.

owner.description: Provider, table/read-model, cache, or service that owns the value.

field.description: Provider field, DB column, or computed field name when applicable.

TrustFreshness.description: Freshness metadata for a trust-critical value. This is separate from transport cache fields in ResponseMeta.

TrustReconciliation.description: How provider-owned facts were reconciled with stored/read-model values.

TrustCompleteness.description: Whether the described value or result set is complete for its stated contract.

TrustMetadata.description: Shared source/freshness/reconciliation/completeness metadata for public API values that may be cached, stale, partial, computed, or provider-unavailable. Unavailable provider values must be represented with explicit metadata instead of fabricated zeros or empty arrays.

DataQualityGroup.description: One group of response fields that share a writer and therefore share a clock.

group.description: Stable snake_case group name. Names are additive across releases, so match on the ones you know and ignore the rest.

owner.description: The table and column that write this group, named so the verdict can be audited (for example trader_rankings.computed_at).

status.description: fresh: served, and as_of carries this group's real observation or computation clock. partial: some of the group's fields are served and some are missing. unknown: served, and this read has no clock for it, so no age may be inferred. untracked: 0xinsider does not track this group for this subject, by design. unavailable: the group could not be served. New values may be added; treat one you do not recognize as unknown. fresh means the group is tracked and clocked, not that it is inside any particular tolerance: compare as_of against your own.

as_of.description: When this group's values were observed or computed. Omitted whenever the read cannot measure it, and never filled with the serialization time, the cache time, or another group's clock.

reason.description: Why the status is not fresh. Omitted when it is.

DataQuality.description: Compact data age and coverage for a response body, always present on the operations that publish it. Read status and as_of to decide whether to use the body at all, and field_groups to see which part is weak. Everything here comes from stored observation clocks, so a cached body reports the same ages a freshly computed one does: meta.cached and meta.cache_age_s stay the only transport-time facts and neither makes this block newer. The per-field audit object is still available through expand=trust; this is the default summary of the same question.

status.description: fresh when every group is fresh, unavailable when every group is unavailable, and partial in every other case.

as_of.description: The oldest as_of among the groups that carry one: the age of the weakest clock this body rests on. Omitted when no group carries a clock.

field_groups.description: One entry per field group. Entries may be added in later releases, so match on group rather than on position or length.

TraderTrust.description: Field-level trust metadata returned only when GET /api/v1/trader/{address} includes expand=trust.

total_pnl.description: Since 2026-10-27 always not_computed: pnl.total is retired and never sent (#29830). The key stays so the object keeps its shape.

realized_pnl.description: Since 2026-10-27 always not_computed: pnl.realized and pnl.exact are retired and never sent (#29830). The key stays so the object keeps its shape.

net_total_pnl.description: Since 2026-10-27 always not_computed: pnl.net_total is retired and never sent (#29830). The key stays so the object keeps its shape.

pnl_correction.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent: it was present only with pnl.correction, which is retired (#29830).

markets_traded.description: Computed, owned by trader_product_scope_records (markets) and dated by the record's computed_at, since 2026-10-27 (#29830). For a wallet that traded no sports or esports market, which never gets a record, owned by traders (last_synced), the completed sync that found none, and dated by it, since 2026-10-29 (#30589, #30657; owned by traders (markets_traded) until #30657).

win_rate.description: Computed, owned by trader_product_scope_records (win_rate) and dated by the record's computed_at, since 2026-10-27 (#29830).

daily_win_rate.description: Since 2026-10-27 always not_computed: stats.daily_win_rate is retired and never sent (#29830). The key stays so the object keeps its shape.

total_volume.description: Computed, owned by trader_trade_daily_rollups (in_scope_volume_total) and dated by traders.last_synced, since 2026-10-27 (#29830).

PlatformCapabilityStatus.description: Every capability the API serves reports supported. The field names a per-capability status so a client can branch on coverage; no other value is emitted.

large_trades.description: The large-trade feed. Canonical key since #16304; whale_signal is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

whale_signal.description: Deprecated spelling of large_trades, emitted beside it with the same value. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read large_trades.

insider_radar.description: Deprecated spelling of suspicious_trades, emitted beside it with the same value. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read suspicious_trades.

id.description: Prefixed ID (pe_...).

event_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the on-chain fill.

action.description: The wallet's own side of this fill: buy or sell.

token_id.description: The Polymarket CLOB token id (ERC1155 asset id, decimal string) for this outcome; null when unavailable (e.g. unsynced markets).

amount_delta.description: Signed share delta (+ on buy, − on sell).

price.description: Fill price in USDC per share, in [0,1].

usdc_notional.description: Positive USDC notional of the fill.

tx_hash.description: Polygon transaction hash of the fill.

running_amount.description: Cumulative signed stored-fill amount for this outcome after this fill, including older pages. Stable across limits/cursors for unchanged source history. Excludes split, merge, redemption and neg-risk activity; not complete holdings. Incomplete fill history can also leave a negative amount.

running_avg_price.description: Cumulative buy-weighted average of stored fills for this outcome, including older pages; not provider current-position avgPrice. Sells do not change this value. 0 when no stored buys have occurred yet.

ExactDecimal.description: A lossless decimal atom rendered from the canonical NUMERIC or provider value. The value is a decimal string and must be parsed with a decimal library; it is never a display string and must not be converted through a binary float. `scale` is the source decimal scale. The field is omitted when its source is unavailable.

value.description: Plain decimal text at full source precision, including a minus sign for negative values and trailing zeros when the source scale carries them. Parse as an arbitrary-precision decimal.

unit.description: Unit of the value, such as `USD`, `USD/share`, or `shares`.

scale.description: Number of digits after the decimal point in `value`'s source atom.

basis.description: Backend-owned source or derivation basis. Treat it as provenance, not as a display label.

PnlCorrection.description: A derived 0xinsider correction to Polymarket's P&L, never a Polymarket value. Polymarket misbooks neg-risk conversions, in both directions: it puts cost on placeholder YES outcomes minted by a conversion and never books it as a loss (negative amount), and its position records leave out shares the wallet really got, such as YES minted by a conversion, so it books no P&L on them (positive amount). Per neg-risk market the wallet converted in, 0xinsider measures Polymarket's own activity cash against the sum of its position P&L, and sums the difference over every measured market whose shares did not move by direct transfer: transferred shares have no activity row, so such a market keeps Polymarket's figure and is counted in markets_excluded. It is published once every neg-risk market with a sports or esports event that the wallet converted in is measured and checked for transfers, and stays as last published until then; a market with no sports or esports event is not measured, and counts only when it was measured before (on the trader body, pnl.correction_pending says so); a sum under $1 either way publishes nothing. The body's own P&L fields keep Polymarket's figures; this object adds the amount and the corrected figures. Money is truncated toward zero to cents.

amount.description: The correction in USD. Negative when Polymarket overstates the wallet.

realized.description: Polymarket's net realized P&L plus amount. Since 2026-10-22 the grade reads this figure's sports and esports share. Omitted when Polymarket's figure is.

net_total.description: Polymarket's net total P&L over every Polymarket market of the wallet, plus amount. Omitted when Polymarket's figure is, and on leaderboard entries.

as_of.description: The newest measurement among the measured markets.

markets_measured.description: Neg-risk markets whose measurement amount sums.

markets_excluded.description: Measured neg-risk markets left out because shares moved in or out of the wallet by direct transfer; they keep Polymarket's figure. Omitted when none.

TraderPnlInScope.description: A wallet's sports and esports record (#27311). basis names the rule behind realized_pnl (#29370): polymarket_sports_esports_v1 is Polymarket's own realized P&L for the wallet in its sports and esports categories, plus the wallet's maker and taker rebates apportioned by its sports and esports share of its Polymarket volume (by cost while Polymarket reports no overall volume) and the in-scope part of any published neg-risk conversion correction; sports_esports_split_v1, used until both of the wallet's category figures are confirmed, is Polymarket's published wallet-wide realized P&L (with any published correction) split into the part earned on sports and esports markets, with fees, refunds and rebates apportioned by cost. Refreshed after each wallet sync and each read of Polymarket's category leaderboards; as_of dates the market counts.

basis.description: The rule behind realized_pnl: polymarket_sports_esports_v1 (Polymarket's sports and esports category figures plus apportioned rebates) or sports_esports_split_v1 (the published realized figure split by cost). A new value means the rule changed; compare figures only within one basis.

realized_pnl.description: Sports and esports realized P&L in USD, display-safe. null when the split basis has no published realized figure to split.

markets.description: Sports and esports markets the wallet has traded, any status.

markets_resolved.description: Of those, the settled markets: the wallet closed its position by selling out, or the market resolved. Its P&L there is final.

win_rate.description: Share of decided sports and esports markets the wallet won, 0 to 1. null with no decided market.

markets_out_of_scope.description: The wallet's markets outside sports and esports, which 0xinsider no longer lists: those it still stores, those whose rows it deleted and counted, and those of other categories first traded since 2026-10-26, which it does not store and counts as the wallet syncs (#30165).

as_of.description: When the record behind these figures was computed.

TraderPnlExact.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent: pnl.exact held the lossless counterpart of the retired wallet-wide pnl.realized (#29830). The member shape below is what the object held before; it is kept so existing type declarations still compile.

realized.description: Native Polymarket realized P&L plus credited maker and taker rebates, with fees included, from the trusted matching `trader_trading_pnl.net_realized_pnl` snapshot.

TraderStatsExact.description: Lossless counterparts for trader statistics. The object is present exactly when stats.total_volume is.

total_volume.description: stats.total_volume as an exact decimal: the sports and esports USD volume, the sum of every stored trade day's `trader_trade_daily_rollups.in_scope_volume_total` (#29830). Polymarket's full-history wallet-wide user volume before 2026-10-27.

PositionExact.description: Lossless position atoms from `wallet_positions`. `shares` and `current_value_usd` are required when this object is present; other source values are omitted when the mirror has no verified value.

id.description: Prefixed ID (trd_...).

streak_tier.description: Hot-streak tier (trailing-7d cross-sectional percentile); a separate axis from the all-time grade. Omitted when there is no recent activity.

forecast_score.description: Optional forecast score on the documented display scale. Null when unavailable.

forecast_evidence.description: Optional measured forecast context. Missing values remain unavailable rather than being inferred.

total.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was Polymarket's all-time leaderboard P&L, which covered every Polymarket market of the wallet, and wallet figures cover sports and esports markets only (#29830). Read pnl.in_scope.realized_pnl.

net_total.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was Polymarket's net total P&L over every Polymarket market of the wallet, and wallet figures cover sports and esports markets only (#29830). Read pnl.in_scope.realized_pnl.

correction.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was the neg-risk conversion correction to the wallet-wide pnl.net_total and pnl.realized (#29830). Its sports and esports part is inside pnl.in_scope.realized_pnl.

correction_pending.description: true while 0xinsider is still checking some of the wallet's converted neg-risk markets with a sports or esports event (not yet measured, measured and not yet checked for transfers, or its latest reads keep failing), so the correction's part inside pnl.in_scope.realized_pnl may change, or arrive where none is published yet. Omitted otherwise.

realized.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was native Polymarket realized P&L over every Polymarket market of the wallet, and wallet figures cover sports and esports markets only (#29830). Read pnl.in_scope.realized_pnl.

unrealized.description: Unrealized P&L in USD of the wallet's open positions on its synced sports and esports markets, from the open-position aggregate (dated by the positions data_quality group). Each open position's market is judged when the aggregate is read (#32119), so a stored position on a market of another category (one that moved out of sports and esports, or one stored before its category was known) is left out. Before 2026-10-27 (#29366) it covered every Polymarket market.

exact.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent: its one member was the lossless counterpart of the retired pnl.realized (#29830).

in_scope.description: Additive (#27311): the wallet's sports and esports record, the figure the 0xinsider profile headlines, dated by the sports_record data_quality group. Omitted until 0xinsider has computed the wallet's record; absent means not computed yet, never zero. Also omitted for a wallet that traded no sports or esports market, which never gets a record: then stats.markets_traded is 0 and the sports_record group is partial with owner traders.last_synced (since 2026-10-29, #30589, #30657). Also omitted for a wallet that trades only combos and holds no single sports or esports market: the record counts single markets, so it has none, stats.markets_traded and stats.win_rate are omitted, and the sports_record group is partial with owner traders.last_synced (since 2026-10-29, #30637). Since 2026-10-27 it is the wallet's only P&L figure besides pnl.unrealized (#29830).

stats.description: Sports and esports markets only since 2026-10-27 (#29830): markets_traded and win_rate come from the wallet's sports and esports record (pnl.in_scope), and total_volume from its stored trade days. A wallet that traded no sports or esports market never gets a record: markets_traded is 0 and win_rate is omitted (since 2026-10-29, #30589, #30657). A wallet that trades only combos has no record either: both are omitted (since 2026-10-29, #30637).

markets_traded.description: Sports and esports markets the wallet traded, any status: pnl.in_scope.markets, dated by the sports_record data_quality group. Omitted until the record is computed. 0 for a wallet that traded no sports or esports market, which never gets a record: at its last completed sync Polymarket counted no market for it, or the sync read its Polymarket positions and found no sports or esports market; none is stored, and no Polymarket sports or esports board lists it; the sports_record group then carries the sync clock (since 2026-10-29, #30589; the second case since #30657). Omitted for a wallet that trades only combos and holds no single sports or esports market, which has no record (since 2026-10-29, #30637). Counted every Polymarket market before 2026-10-27.

win_rate.description: Won over decided sports and esports markets, 0 to 1: pnl.in_scope.win_rate truncated to four places, dated by the sports_record data_quality group. Omitted until the record is computed, while the wallet has no decided sports or esports market, for a wallet that traded no sports or esports market (#30589, #30657), and for one that trades only combos (#30637). Counted every Polymarket market before 2026-10-27.

daily_win_rate.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It counted mark-to-market days over every Polymarket market of the wallet (#29830). Read stats.all.win_days and stats.all.loss_days from GET /api/v1/trader/{address}/pnl, which count sports and esports days.

total_volume.description: Sports and esports USD volume, all time: the sum of every stored trade day's in-scope volume (trader_trade_daily_rollups.in_scope_volume_total), the profile's Volume traded. Dated by the volume data_quality group, which carries the trader sync clock. 0 for a synced wallet with no stored trade day. Omitted before the wallet's first completed sync and while any stored day's in-scope volume is not computed yet, so a partial sum is never served. Polymarket's full-history wallet-wide volume before 2026-10-27 (#29830).

exact.description: Additive lossless counterpart to `total_volume`, present exactly when it is.

strategy_type.description: Observed trading style identifier. New rows use two_sided, category_focused, high_activity, diversified, mixed, or unclassified, counted over the wallet's sports and esports markets only. Historical identifiers remain readable during normal reclassification; style does not predict skill or intent.

category_strengths.description: Per-category rank context when expand=categories is requested. Values include available rank, category totals, performance and record counts; scaled_total_pnl is a legacy alias of total_pnl. Its measurement basis and update timing differ from the plain record returned by GET /api/v1/trader/{address}/categories, so the two need not agree. Use this for rank context and that route for the plain record. Sports and esports only (#28761): keys are sports and esports categories, and a category outside them is omitted, as on that route. The inner key-set is intentionally unconstrained and may contain additional compatibility fields.

quant_metrics.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. These advanced risk and performance metrics covered every Polymarket market of the wallet, and wallet figures cover sports and esports markets only (#29589). expand=quant_metrics is still accepted and adds nothing. For the sports and esports record read pnl.in_scope here, and GET /api/v1/trader/{address}/pnl for its daily series. The member shape below is what the object held before; it is kept so existing type declarations still compile.

smart_score.description: Trader smart score on a 0..100 display scale; higher is stronger. Null when unavailable.

copy_score.description: Copyability score, 0-100. Same base as smart_score minus penalties for traits that make a strategy hard to replicate: -20 if fewer than 50 markets traded, -15 if positions are highly concentrated, -15 if position sizing exceeds about 2x Kelly, -10 if the largest loss on one settled market exceeds 30% of the capital the wallet deployed across all its positions, -10 if edge is inconsistent; result clamped to 0-100. Higher means easier to follow. null when insufficient history.

sharpe_30d.description: Sharpe ratio over the trailing 30 days (risk-adjusted return; higher is better). Magnitude can be large for small samples. null when insufficient history.

sharpe_7d.description: Sharpe ratio over the trailing 7 days (risk-adjusted return; higher is better). null when insufficient history.

profit_factor.description: Gross profit divided by gross loss; greater than 1 is profitable. Capped at 1000 when there are effectively no losses. null when insufficient history.

edge_consistency.description: Share of the trader's last 30 days with realized P&L that closed positive, 0-1 (higher is more consistent). A day with no realized P&L is not one of them, so the window can span months. null below 10 such days; null never means 0.

sharpe_percentile.description: Cross-sectional percentile rank of the trader's Sharpe ratio versus all traders, 0-100. null when insufficient history.

pf_percentile.description: Cross-sectional percentile rank of profit factor versus all traders, 0-100. null when insufficient history.

consistency_percentile.description: Cross-sectional percentile rank of edge consistency versus all traders, 0-100. null when insufficient history.

last_active.description: When the wallet last traded: its most recent recorded trade, the same value the leaderboard entry's last_active carries (which re-reads it hourly). A cached body (meta.cached true) can lag a new trade by up to 60 seconds. No data_quality group dates it: the value is itself a trade time. Since 2026-11-02 (#32324); before, it carried the time 0xinsider last synced the wallet, the same value as synced_at. Omitted when the wallet has no recorded trade.

synced_at.description: When 0xinsider last completed a sync of the wallet (traders.last_synced), dated by the sync data_quality group. Not when the wallet traded: read last_active for that.

data_quality.description: Data age and coverage for this trader body. Always present. Its six groups are sync (traders.last_synced, covering synced_at and sync_status; it covered last_active until 2026-11-02, #32324, and no group covers last_active now, since the value is itself a trade time), sports_record (trader_product_scope_records.computed_at, covering pnl.in_scope, stats.markets_traded and stats.win_rate: unavailable until the wallet's sports and esports record is computed, partial while it has no decided sports or esports market; for a wallet that traded no sports or esports market, which never gets a record, partial with owner traders.last_synced, as of the completed sync that found none, stats.markets_traded 0 and pnl.in_scope and stats.win_rate omitted, since 2026-10-29, #30589, #30657; for a wallet that trades only combos and holds no single sports or esports market, partial with owner traders.last_synced and all three omitted, since 2026-10-29, #30637), ranking (trader_rankings.computed_at, covering grade, score, streak_tier, forecast_score and forecast_evidence), leaderboard_rank (leaderboard_rank_refresh_state.completed_at, the completion time of the latest fully completed global rank refresh, covering rank), volume (traders.last_synced, covering stats.total_volume, the sum of the trade days the sync stores: unavailable before the first completed sync and while a stored day's sports and esports volume is not computed) and positions (trader_position_snapshots.last_refreshed_at with traders.last_synced as fallback, covering pnl.unrealized, the open-position aggregate). Since 2026-10-27 (#29830) there is no leaderboard_pnl group, and volume is dated by the sync clock instead of trader_usd_volume.observed_at. The positions clock is the latest successful /positions snapshot when one exists, otherwise the last completed trader sync. A rank or position value remains unknown or unavailable when its clock or value is absent. For an unknown wallet every group is unavailable. If the open-position read itself fails, positions is unavailable with a reason that says so, pnl.unrealized is absent, and the body is answered fresh (meta.cached false) and is not kept for later callers.

trust.description: Field-level trust metadata. Present only when expand=trust or expand[]=trust is requested.

category_records.description: Current evidence for observed and known categories (expand=categories or expand[]=categories). Omitted unless expanded. Includes insufficient, stale, unknown and degraded rows; absence of a category is not proof of skill. The global grade is unchanged. Sports and esports only (#28827): a category outside them is omitted, as on GET /api/v1/trader/{address}/categories.

position_summary.description: Aggregate position and P&L coverage for the trader, over its synced markets. markets_open, unrealized_mtm and cost_basis_locked cover the open positions on sports and esports markets, each market judged when the summary is read (#32119). markets_synced, markets_resolved and the resolved win figures count every stored market: since 2026-10-27 (#29366) those are mostly sports and esports markets, but a market that moved out of sports and esports, or one stored before its category was known, stays in them, and sync_coverage counts every category on both sides. markets_total, total_realized_pnl and synced_realized_pnl still cover every Polymarket market of the wallet. Omitted entirely (key absent, never null) when the trader is not in the local database or native net economics is unavailable. Realized fields remain numbers when present, including a genuine zero.

markets_total.description: Polymarket's count of the markets the wallet traded, every category, when known; null when the provider total is unavailable.

markets_synced.description: Markets with locally synced position rows.

markets_pruned.description: Markets outside sports and esports that the wallet traded and whose synced rows 0xinsider deleted, counted when they were deleted (from 2026-10-27, #29366); 0 when none were. Not in markets_synced or any other count here; sync_coverage adds it to markets_synced so both sides of that ratio count every category.

markets_unstored.description: Markets outside sports and esports that the wallet first traded since 2026-10-26, which 0xinsider does not store, counted as the wallet syncs (#30165); 0 when none are. Not in markets_synced, markets_pruned or any other count here; sync_coverage adds it with markets_pruned to markets_synced.

markets_combo.description: Combo markets the wallet traded, as maker or taker, counted from the combo fills 0xinsider indexes from the chain (#30218); 0 when it traded none. Polymarket counts each combo as one market in markets_total, and no position read lists one, so a combo is in no other count here; sync_coverage adds it with markets_pruned and markets_unstored to markets_synced.

markets_resolved.description: Synced markets the wallet has settled: it closed its position by selling out, or the market resolved. Its P&L there is final.

markets_open.description: Synced sports and esports markets still open with residual value (open positions with current value > 0); a stored market of another category is left out (#32119).

sync_coverage.description: markets_synced plus markets_pruned plus markets_unstored plus markets_combo, divided by markets_total when the provider total is known (capped at 1.0); 0.0-1.0. Both sides count every category: no Polymarket count of a wallet's sports and esports markets exists, so the ratio does not estimate one. When markets_total is unknown or not positive (null, 0, or negative), this is 1.0 if that sum is positive (else 0.0), so cross-check markets_total before treating 1.0 as full coverage.

synced_realized_pnl.description: Native net realized P&L (USD) over every Polymarket market of the wallet, including credited rebates, minus the stored realized component of synced open positions with positive current value. Rebates are credited to the account, not to a position, so every credited rebate stays in this figure. NUMERIC arithmetic precedes conversion to a JSON number.

total_realized_pnl.description: Native net realized P&L (USD) over every Polymarket market of the wallet, including credited rebates, read directly from the accounting snapshot. For the sports and esports figure read trader.pnl.in_scope.realized_pnl. Position sync_coverage is separate from this accounting basis.

unrealized_mtm.description: Mark-to-market unrealized P&L (USD) on open positions in synced sports and esports markets (#32119).

cost_basis_locked.description: Cost basis (USD) currently tied up in open positions in synced sports and esports markets (#32119).

resolved_win_rate.description: Win rate as a percentage (0-100): resolved_wins over resolved_decided. A settled market that closed at exactly zero realized P&L (a void, a refund, a fully hedged position) is neither a win nor a loss and is not in the denominator, the same rule the leaderboard applies; null when no resolved market was decided. It is the rule of trader.stats.win_rate, read from the synced rows at request time; stats.win_rate is the stored figure the profile shows, refreshed by each sync and a few minutes after a closed-history write. context.md prints one Market win rate, stats.win_rate.

resolved_wins.description: Settled markets that closed at positive realized P&L: the win-rate numerator. Additive; null only on a summary cached before the field existed.

resolved_decided.description: Settled markets that closed at a non-zero realized P&L: the win-rate denominator. At most markets_resolved; the difference is markets settled at exactly zero or with an unknown P&L. Additive; null only on a summary cached before the field existed.

as_of.description: RFC3339 freshness of the served OPEN-position data: the trader's latest /positions snapshot, else the last completed sync. The snapshot advances ONLY open positions, so read this as the open-position freshness clock -- the resolved/closed aggregates on this same summary (markets_resolved, resolved_win_rate) advance only on a full sync. The value is the /positions snapshot instant when one exists, so it is typically at or just before the trader-level last sync on a normal sync, and can be AFTER it while the active-view loop refreshes open positions between full syncs. This clock does not establish native accounting freshness. Always present on the wire (serialized as JSON null when the trader has neither a snapshot nor a sync); never omitted.

data_as_of.description: RFC3339 freshness of the OPEN-position-level data: when a position_summary is present this mirrors its as_of byte-for-byte (latest /positions snapshot, else last completed sync) -- the open-position freshness clock, since the snapshot advances only open positions; otherwise the trader's last completed sync, even if an unserved position snapshot exists. Null when the selected clock is unavailable; a missing breakdown does not establish position or accounting freshness.

freshness_note.description: Human-readable statement of the point-in-time snapshot semantics (data_as_of is the open-position clock -- the latest /positions snapshot, else the last completed sync; the snapshot advances only open positions, so resolved counts and win rate can include settled markets recorded after the last full sync; native realized P&L follows its accounting snapshot -- not a live feed; re-fetch for fresher data).

id.description: Composite prefixed ID `pos_<wallet>:<condition_id>:<outcome_index>`.

side.description: Binary outcome side. Non-binary positions are not surfaced on V1.

token_id.description: The Polymarket CLOB token id (ERC1155 asset id, decimal string) for this outcome; null when unavailable (e.g. unsynced markets).

shares.description: Live share count from the wallet_positions mirror.

avg_price.description: Volume-weighted entry price for this leg.

current_value_usd.description: Current mark-to-market value in USD (always non-null on V1 — pre-reconcile rows are excluded).

cash_pnl.description: Unrealized P&L for the open position (Polymarket `cashPnl`).

exact.description: Additive lossless source atoms for the display-safe position fields. Parse every `value` with decimal-safe arithmetic; never recover exact values from the numeric twins.

last_reconciled_at.description: Max updated_at across mirror legs for this pair.

freshness.description: Backend-computed staleness bucket derived from last_reconciled_at.

id.description: Prefixed ID (`trd_...`).

win_rate.description: Sports and esports win rate as a ratio from 0 to 1 (0.62 means 62%): wins over the decided sports and esports markets on the wallet's record, the same figure as pnl.in_scope.win_rate and stats.win_rate on GET /api/v1/trader/{address}. Since 2026-10-27 it no longer counts other markets (#29953). Absent when the wallet has no record or no decided market.

pnl.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was Polymarket's net total P&L over every Polymarket market of the wallet, and wallet figures cover sports and esports markets only (#29953). Read trader.in_scope_realized_pnl.

in_scope_realized_pnl.description: The wallet's realized P&L in USD on sports and esports markets, the figure the 0xinsider profile shows: the record behind pnl.in_scope.realized_pnl on GET /api/v1/trader/{address}, to cents. For a graded wallet it is read from the latest grading pass, so it can trail that figure until the next pass. Omitted until 0xinsider has computed the wallet's record (#29953).

markets.description: Sports and esports markets on the wallet's record, pnl.in_scope.markets on GET /api/v1/trader/{address}. Since 2026-10-27 it no longer counts other markets (#29953). Absent when the wallet has no record.

wallet_age_days.description: Days since the wallet's first-seen time. For a wallet 0xinsider first recorded on or after March 21, 2026, that is when 0xinsider recorded it. For a wallet recorded earlier, it is usually the wallet's first Polymarket activity, so the age can run to years. It is not the wallet's on-chain age or the time of its first trade. Absent when the first-seen time is unknown.

is_new_wallet.description: True when wallet_age_days is under the new-wallet threshold (30 days), which means 0xinsider first recorded the wallet in the last 30 days. False when wallet_age_days is absent. This public V1 field is first-seen recency, not the wallet's on-chain age.

id.description: Prefixed ID (`mkt_...`).

outcome_label.description: Provider-reported outcome label (e.g. team name for sports). Separate from `side` because provider labels can diverge from the binary Yes/No axis.

id.description: Prefixed ID (wt_...).

outcome.description: Traded outcome label (e.g. "Yes"/"No"/team name), resolved provider-first from the trade's outcome_index against market_canonical (index 0 -> yes, 1 -> no). Distinct axis from side (BUY/SELL): side is the trade direction, outcome is which leg was traded. null for multi-outcome (outcome_index >= 2) or unsynced markets, and for a Polymarket trade recorded before 2026-04-02T00:00:00Z unless its stored outcome_index was verified against the fill's own trade records (before that date the stored index was wrong for a large share of trades; an unverified side is unknown, not defaulted).

token_id.description: The Polymarket CLOB token id (ERC1155 asset id, decimal string) for the traded outcome; null when unavailable (e.g. unsynced markets) and for a Polymarket trade recorded before 2026-04-02T00:00:00Z whose traded side is not verified (the same rule as outcome).

review_score.description: Current trade review score on a 0..1 scale; higher values indicate a stronger review signal. This is the current response value and can differ from the recorded score. Missing measurements remain unavailable.

signal_score.description: Deprecated alias of review_score with the same current value and 0..1 scale. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read review_score.

recorded_review_score.description: 0.0–1.0 review score written once when the trade row is inserted, from the trader's statistics at that moment. Populated from 2026-08-03T11:59Z; older rows return null and are never backfilled, because a backfill could only read today's statistics. If a trade is added later, its time-sensitive recorded score reflects that delay. Canonical since #16311; recorded_signal_score carries the same value.

recorded_signal_score.description: 0.0–1.0 review score written once when the trade row is inserted; null before 2026-08-03T11:59Z. Deprecated (#16311): `recorded_review_score` is the canonical spelling and carries the same value; this key stays on the wire until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352), when it is removed.

suspicion_score.description: Persisted live suspicion score from the scorer. Null when the row has no persisted score.

suspicion_track.description: Persisted scorer track. Null when a legacy row has no stored track label.

market_volume_share.description: This fill's size relative to its market: its share count (size_usd / price) divided by the shares the market has traded, Polymarket's recorded volume, which counts shares rather than dollars, as observed at or after the trade, so the value always falls between 0 and 1 inclusive. A 20,000-share fill is 0.00005 of a market that has traded 400M shares and 0.125 of one that has traded 160,000, which size_usd alone cannot distinguish. Absent when no volume figure recorded at or after the trade is available, or when that figure is smaller than the fill; never 0 as a stand-in and never capped at 1, because a denominator we cannot trust publishes nothing rather than a trimmed number. A market's volume keeps growing, so the same trade reports a smaller share as the market trades on.

grade.description: The trader's grade today, on every row however old. For what the grade was when the trade happened, read grade_at_trade.

grade_at_trade.description: The grade the trader held when the trade happened, from recorded grade history (recorded from 2026-09-19T23:00Z). Null unless grade_at_trade_status is graded. Never today's grade projected backward.

grade_at_trade_status.description: graded: grade_at_trade holds the recorded grade. ungraded: the trader was recorded without a grade at that moment. unknown: no record covers the moment, which is every trade before 2026-09-19T23:00Z and a trade that fell between a grade change and its confirmation. unknown never means ungraded.

execution_wallet.description: Lowercase Polygon wallet from the exact OrderFilled log.

last_traded_at.description: Latest nonfuture recorded wallet-wide trade time for the tracked trader supplying this participant's grade. Omitted when unavailable; not the receipt time or the owner EOA's activity. Trader context is read with the response and is not frozen by execution membership snapshots.

profile_segment.description: 0xinsider profile path segment for this participant, present only when the execution wallet has a tracked trader: `@<username>` when that username resolves to the trader alone, otherwise the trader's lowercase wallet. Percent-encode the part after `@` and append to `https://0xinsider.com/profile/`.

share_pct.description: Participant share of the exact execution, from 0 through 100.

exchange_family.description: Polymarket exchange contract that emitted the execution: `ctf_v2` the CTF Exchange v2, `neg_risk_ctf_v2` the Neg Risk CTF Exchange v2, `exchange_v3` ExchangeV3, which settles Polymarket Protocol V2 binary and neg-risk markets. Treat an unknown value as another exchange.

makers_next_cursor.description: Stable cursor after the last maker included in the bounded inline page.

snapshot_id.description: Deterministic immutable membership snapshot for this detail response.

analysis_id.description: Stable digest binding page cursors to one snapshot and execution set.

executions_next_cursor.description: Stable cursor after the last execution included in the bounded inline page.

next_cursor.description: Cursor bound to the analysis, execution, last full-denominator share total, and wallet.

grade.description: All-time trader grade (S, A, B, C, D, F).

last_traded_at.description: The wallet's most recent recorded trade time, stamped at serve time from its current trader record rather than frozen with the pick. Always sent; null when no trade time is recorded.

profile_segment.description: 0xinsider profile path segment this wallet links to: `@<username>` when that username resolves to this wallet alone, otherwise the lowercase wallet. Percent-encode the part after `@` and append to `https://0xinsider.com/profile/`. Stamped at serve time; absent on a body cached before the field shipped.

entry_value_usd.description: USD entry value of this wallet's position: `shares` times the pick's frozen `backed_price`. An entry valuation, never a live balance or the provider's current value. Omitted when the holder snapshot has no valid price.

category_win_rate.description: This wallet's win rate in the pick's canonical category bucket (the pick's `category` field, e.g. Basketball -- label the rate with it, never with the narrower `display_category` league, except when `category_win_rate_game` is present, in which case the rate is that game's or league's and is labelled with it): the share of the wallet's settled markets in that category (it closed its position by selling out, or the market resolved) whose realized P&L closed positive, as a 0..1 fraction. Present only with `category_win_rate_status` = `measured`, on `display_holders` entries, and only when the wallet clears the settled-market floor; recomputed at serve time from the current category read model, not frozen with the pick. Absent on `holders` entries, legacy rows, and payloads predating the field.

wins.description: Settled markets in the category that this wallet closed with a profit.

decided.description: Settled markets in the category that this wallet closed with a profit or a loss. A market resolved at zero realized P&L is in neither count.

category_win_record.description: The two counts `category_win_rate` is the ratio of, read from the same row: `wins / decided` equals the rate. Counts every settled Polymarket market the wallet traded (it closed its position by selling out, or the market resolved) in the pick's canonical category (or in its game or league, when `category_win_rate_game` is present), at any position size; the counts are rebuilt daily. Present only with `category_win_rate_status` = `measured`; absent otherwise and on payloads predating the field.

category_avg_price.description: The wallet's average entry price in the pick's canonical category, as a 0..1 fraction of $1 (0.98 is 98 cents). Its sample is the wallet's markets in that category that resolved to a winning side, of $20 or more where it bought one side at a known price, so it can differ from the `category_win_record` sample. A wallet that buys near-certain outcomes wins almost every time, so read the win rate beside this price. Present only with `category_win_rate_status` = `measured`, and only when that sample has at least 5 markets. When `category_win_rate_game` is present the price is still the whole `category` bucket's: this field has no per-game or per-league price. Absent otherwise and on payloads predating the field.

category_win_rate_game.description: Where `category_win_rate` and `category_win_record` were measured, by the same name the pick's `display_category` uses for it: for an esports pick the game (`LoL`, `CS2`, `Dota 2`, `Valorant`, `Call of Duty`, `Honor of Kings`, `Mobile Legends: Bang Bang`, `Overwatch`, `Rainbow Six Siege`, `Rocket League` or `StarCraft II`), and for a pick in a registered league that league (`NBA`, `NFL`, `NHL`, `MLB`, `UFC`, `ATP`, `WTA`, `LaLiga`, `Premier League`, `Serie A`, `UEFA Champions League`, `MLS` and the other registered leagues). Present only when the wallet's record there clears the 5-settled-market floor, in which case the rate and record are the game's or league's rather than the whole `category` bucket's. Absent when the rate is the bucket's (the wallet's history there is under the floor, or the competition is not a registered league), on every other pick, beside every non-measured status, and on payloads predating the field. Label the rate with this when present and with `category` otherwise.

category_win_rate_status.description: Why `category_win_rate` is present or absent on a `display_holders` entry: `measured` (rate present), `not_enough_data` (the wallet is below the settled-market floor of 5 in the category), or `unavailable` (the annotation read failed; retry later). Never `untracked`: every recorded holder is a graded wallet 0xinsider has on file. Absent entirely on `holders` entries, legacy rows, and payloads predating the field -- absence means the roster was never annotated, not a small sample.

wallet_age_days.description: Whole days since this wallet's first trade, rounded down (3.6 days reads 3), so it changes once a day, not on every request, and the pick's ETag holds between requests. Stamped at serve time from the wallet's current trader record, never frozen with the pick. The five badge fields are present together, and only for a wallet that carries at least one badge; all absent means no badge, or a body cached before the fields shipped.

is_new_wallet.description: True when the wallet's first trade was under 30 days ago. Stamped at serve time from the wallet's current trader record, never frozen with the pick. The five badge fields are present together, and only for a wallet that carries at least one badge; all absent means no badge, or a body cached before the fields shipped.

markets_traded.description: Distinct markets this wallet has traded. Stamped at serve time from the wallet's current trader record, never frozen with the pick. The five badge fields are present together, and only for a wallet that carries at least one badge; all absent means no badge, or a body cached before the fields shipped.

is_bot.description: True when the wallet has traded 10,000 or more distinct markets, the breadth floor 0xinsider uses to mark automated wallets. It is a breadth rule, not proof of automation. Stamped at serve time from the wallet's current trader record, never frozen with the pick. The five badge fields are present together, and only for a wallet that carries at least one badge; all absent means no badge, or a body cached before the fields shipped.

x_username.description: The wallet's X handle from its Polymarket profile, normalized to 1-15 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_] with no `@`. Link it as `https://x.com/<handle>`. Stamped at serve time from the wallet's current trader record, never frozen with the pick. The five badge fields are present together, and only for a wallet that carries at least one badge; all absent means no badge, or a body cached before the fields shipped.

ScheduledPickSlot.description: An entitled same-day slot with a future scheduled release: stable identity and backend-owned release/kickoff instants. It leaves this list at its release instant; an unpublished slot is never a delayed recommendation. No matchup, category, platform, side, price, or holder fields appear before release. Unauthorized scheduled ranks appear only in locked_picks.

pick_rank.description: Deprecated compatibility daily release slot; use pick_id for identity and publication_order for scheduling.

release_at.description: The slot's future release instant. Remove this preview at that instant and read again for published picks; a scheduled slot does not guarantee publication.

kickoff.description: The backed game's current kickoff instant.

pick_id.description: Stable pick row identity as decimal text. Never use a quality rank as identity.

publication_order.description: Compatibility release slot. No quality claim; historic scheduling order is retained.

is_free_selection.description: Viewer-independent free selection designation. New rows store it explicitly; historic null storage uses the original free slot.

supersedes_pick_id.description: Deprecated (#24157): always null. No replacement lineage was ever recorded in this field; the key stays so existing V1 clients keep parsing. Identify a pick by pick_id.

state.description: Full success containing entitled proof-readable picks.

pick_rank.description: Deprecated compatibility daily release slot; use pick_id for identity and publication_order for scheduling.

picks.description: Published picks for this product day in the returned display order. Use pick_id for identity.

pick_count.description: Number of items in `picks`: the proof-readable picks. Picks held in `proof_pending_picks` are not counted.

scheduled_picks.description: Rank-ordered entitled selections that have not released. Every row retains release_at and kickoff; unauthorized scheduled ranks appear only in identity-free locked_picks.

category.description: Recorded canonical sport category. Prefer display_category for the public competition label.

display_category.description: Frozen public presentation category. Tennis uses the provider-verified ATP or WTA tour, including Wimbledon and doubles; unknown tours retain Tennis. Every men's and women's cricket competition uses Cricket. Other sports use the curated league, esports title or soccer competition label, then the provider series name without its season year, then category when no competition is known. The canonical category and measured cohort are unchanged: an esports title still uses the pooled Esports category. Optional for mixed-version client compatibility.

release_at.description: The pick's stored release instant. Use the returned timestamp; published_at records when publication occurred.

is_locked.description: True only before the pick's stored release instant (a pre-release embargo flag); effectively always false on a served, already-published pick. To detect that the backed game has kicked off, use `game_started`.

game_started.description: True once the backed game's kickoff has passed (kickoff <= now). When true the snapshotted pre-game price is no longer actionable. Absent for a legacy pick with no stored kickoff (treat as not-started).

game_ended.description: Whether the backed game is over according to the cached live scoreboard, read at serve time. Tells a finished game from one still in play before `outcome` settles. Omitted when the pick has no event slug or no scoreboard is cached for it; absence is unknown, never false.

outcome.description: Settlement outcome of the backed side; 'pending' until the market resolves.

outcome_display.description: Pre-formatted SETTLEMENT STATUS for display: "Win" / "Loss" / "Void" / "Pending" -- the outcome enum above as a label. Convenience only; outcome is the source value. NOTE: this is the win/loss STATUS, not the backed side. The backed side is pick_outcome_label ("Belgium (-2.5)") -- a different field answering a different question.

pick_outcome_label.description: The backed side phrased as a bet: a team for a moneyline (e.g. "Portugal"), the handicap line for a spread (e.g. "Belgium (-2.5)"), or "{team} to advance" for a knockout advancement market (e.g. "Spain to advance").

token_id.description: The Polymarket CLOB token id (ERC1155 asset id, decimal string) for the backed outcome; omitted when unavailable (e.g. unsynced markets).

position.description: The backed side phrased as a bet (e.g. "Portugal to win").

side_summary.description: One-line summary of which side sharp money is backing. Required on every item in `picks`: a current-day published pick whose required holder proof is not safely readable is listed in `proof_pending_picks` instead of being served with a partial success shape or a synthetic zero, and the route returns 503 read_model_warming only when no published pick has readable proof.

sharp_wallet_count.description: S/A wallet count on the backed side in the public V1 compatibility projection.

smart_wallet_count.description: Deprecated spelling of sharp_wallet_count with the same value.

top_grade.description: Best recorded S/A grade in the public V1 compatibility projection.

sharp_usd.description: Recorded sharp-money magnitude in USD when available.

smart_usd.description: Deprecated spelling of sharp_usd with the same value.

backed_price.description: Frozen pre-game probability (0..1) for the backed side, written once at publication. It is the Polymarket CLOB order book midpoint at release, not an executed fill: a buyer lifts the ask, so a subscriber's own entry is usually a little worse than this price.

entry_price_note.description: Full-only disclosure when backed_price was recovered from provider history within 30 seconds before publication. Render beside the price. Absent for ordinary publication captures and teasers; this is a historical reference, not an executed fill.

odds_display.description: Pre-formatted backed_price as cents-on-the-dollar odds, to ONE decimal: "62.0c" / "99.9c". Never rounded to a whole cent -- a 99.9c favorite is not a 100c certainty. Convenience only; backed_price is the source value. Omitted when backed_price is.

stake_usd.description: The flat stake the published record puts on every pick, in USD: 1000 since 2026-09-22 (it was 100 before). Present exactly when return_usd is, so a reader never has to know the stake from anywhere else.

return_usd.description: Gross return of stake_usd at the frozen midpoint price (stake_usd / backed_price). A real fill pays the ask, so an executed stake usually returns a little less. Omitted with backed_price.

return_per_100.description: The same return on a literal $100 (100 / backed_price), kept for compatibility: the field predates stake_usd and its name promises the $100 basis, so a client that scales it to its own stake stays right. Present exactly when return_usd is.

payout_display.description: Pre-formatted return_usd as USD with cents and thousands separators: "$1,612.90" / "$12,500.00". The GROSS return (the stake included), so it carries no sign. Convenience only; return_usd is the source value. Omitted when return_usd is.

profit_display.description: Pre-formatted PROFIT on the stake -- return_usd minus stake_usd, i.e. the payout net of what you put in -- as a signed USD string: "+$612.90". Distinct from payout_display, which is gross. Omitted when return_usd is.

clv_status.description: Backend-owned CLV capture disposition. "pending" means no capture decision exists yet; terminal provider or quality statuses remain distinguishable. The raw close price and timestamp are never serialized.

clv_basis.description: Backend-owned CLV evidence basis. `frozen_displayed_entry` uses the persisted displayed entry. `historical_provider_entry` uses a known-CLOB point at or before publication. `historical_provider_price_match` requires the latest point in the prior hour to match. `historical_provider_nearby_price_match` requires a matching point within five minutes before publication. Source-null bases preserve unknown original provenance.

clv_pct.description: Closing-line value toward the backed side, computed as (close / entry - 1) * 100. The basis-specific provider p entry must match the stored display; historical_provider_price_match also requires source provenance to remain null and its latest entry to be within the one-hour window at or before publication. Every basis requires a later quality-checked p close from the same series in the bounded post-entry, pre-kickoff window. Omitted when not measured.

clv_display.description: Backend-formatted signed CLV percentage, present exactly when clv_pct is present.

clv_explanation.description: Backend-owned CLV formula text with the entry probability, close probability, and rounded result. Provider timestamps remain private.

unit_score.description: Net return for the pick in stake units (return_usd / stake_usd - 1); one unit is one stake_usd stake, and the figure is the same under any stake size. Omitted when the outcome is not valued.
