unit_score_display.description: Backend-formatted signed unit score, present exactly when unit_score is present.

sharp_pct.description: Recorded sharp-money share as a 0..1 fraction when available. This is not a winning probability.

market_pct.description: Recorded market-implied probability as a 0..1 fraction when available.

qualifying_expert.description: Optional recorded specialist facts on a full response. These describe the trader, not the pick's win probability. Omitted when no recorded specialist is available.

name.description: Provider display name, or null for an unnamed wallet.

grade.description: Recorded trader grade. Public V1 preserves its S/A compatibility projection.

canonical_category.description: The canonical sport bucket the win rate was measured over (for example Basketball). Can be BROADER than the pick's display_category, which names an exact league such as NBA — label the rate with this field, never with display_category.

win_rate.description: Share of the trader’s settled markets in canonical_category (closed by selling out, or resolved) with positive realized P&L, as a 0..1 fraction. Null when not measured. This is a trader statistic, not the pick’s probability of winning.

n_resolved.description: Number of settled markets behind win_rate; null when not measured.

position_usd.description: Recorded Polymarket position value on the backed outcome, in USD. It can change after this snapshot.

opposite_position_usd.description: Recorded position value on the other outcome of this market, in USD. Omitted when not recorded; zero is a measured value.

stats_computed_at.description: Timestamp of the recorded trader statistics.

traders.description: Public V1 S/A wallet count on the backed side, equal to sharp_wallet_count.

backed_sharp_usd.description: Recorded aggregate backed-side position value in USD when available, not a live balance or entry cost. The display_holders roster can include additional wallets; use the returned aggregate rather than summing that roster.

holders.description: Bounded S/A holder display projection from the recorded snapshot. Historical rows retain their recorded display shape.

display_holders.description: Optional recorded holder roster in display order, with lead_backer first when present. Preserve the returned order. The roster can include wallets outside the recorded count and aggregate fields; do not derive holder_count, wallet counts or backed_sharp_usd from its length or a sum. Position values are gross holdings on the backed outcome and can coexist with holdings on the other outcome. Historical rows retain their recorded display shape.

holder_count.description: S/A holder count for the public V1 compatibility projection. display_holders can include additional grades.

thesis.description: Display-ready explanation of the recorded pick. Render the returned text rather than reconstructing it from holder counts or grades.

polymarket_url.description: Where this pick's outbound Polymarket link lands: Polymarket's own redirect answer for `/event/<event_slug>`, carrying the referral tag. Omitted until that redirect has been resolved; link to the event page instead when it is absent.

event_slug.description: The canonical /event game-page slug (one neutral page per game); omitted when the game has no neutral event page.

event_link_slug.description: Backend-resolved /event destination slug for the source market. Omitted outside full responses; null is an authoritative no-link decision.

sports_context.description: Provider-first sports context for the pick's market (team logos, league branding, live score). Full-state only; omitted when the pick is not a team-sports market.

disclaimer.description: Risk disclaimer shown with every pick.

proof_pending_picks.description: Entitled published picks whose holder proof is unreadable, ordered by rank. Unauthorized ranks appear only in locked_picks and cannot trigger proof warming. Read retry_at for the next read.

entry_authorization.description: Optional full-response entry authorization. Missing or expired authorization cannot authorize an automated entry.

locked_picks.description: Unauthorized unresolved published or scheduled ranks. Contains no game, provider identity, price, or identifying clock. Pro may upgrade to Max to open these ranks.

message.description: Actionable status, including Upgrade to Max when only locked ranks are published.

pick_id.description: Stable pick row identity as decimal text. Never use a quality rank as identity.

publication_order.description: Compatibility release slot. No quality claim; historic scheduling order is retained.

is_free_selection.description: Viewer-independent free selection designation. New rows store it explicitly; historic null storage uses the original free slot.

supersedes_pick_id.description: Deprecated (#24157): always null. No replacement lineage was ever recorded in this field; the key stays so existing V1 clients keep parsing. Identify a pick by pick_id.

lead_backer.description: Optional full-only lead wallet publication facts. Omitted on legacy picks or when the recorded evidence is unavailable.

PickSportsContext.description: Provider-first sports context for a Pick of the Day market: team crests, league branding, and live score. Each team `logo` is a registered club crest or national flag as a same-origin path where one exists, and provider artwork otherwise.

league_name.description: League or competition display name (e.g. "Premier League").

competition_label.description: Provider-owned event taxonomy from Gamma eventMetadata, joined in league · serie · tournament order with blanks and case-insensitive duplicates removed. A tennis qualifying match ends in ", Qualification", including an ATP Challenger qualifying match, which Gamma marks only in eventMetadata.tennisFixtureSource. Separate from league_name; omitted when the provider does not supply the metadata.

yes_team.description: The team mapped to the market's YES outcome, or the parent-event home/first team when event_matchup is true.

no_team.description: The team mapped to the market's NO outcome, or the parent-event away/second team when event_matchup is true.

game_id.description: Provider game identifier (Polymarket Gamma gameId); omitted when the provider supplies none.

event_matchup.description: Always present. True when the two teams are the parent-event match identity for a teamless binary leg (e.g. a draw, totals, or prop market), not the market's own outcomes.

event_subject_team.description: Present only alongside event_matchup: the event team the binary leg is about (provider group_item_title matched to a matchup team, e.g. Belgium for "Will Belgium win?"), i.e. the winner on a Yes resolution. Omitted for teamless legs (draw, totals, prop).

matchup_title.description: The two teams as a single whole-game label, joined "<home> – <away>" (en-dash) in provider display order (e.g. "Portugal – Uzbekistan"). Composed server-side from the provider team names (no title/slug parsing). Present when both teams resolve a name; omitted for single-subject, teamless, or non-two-team contexts.

PickSportsTeam.description: A single sports team or competitor in a Pick of the Day market's sports context. Identity and score fields are provider-owned and nullable. The structured score fields (`sets`, `format`, `sets_won`) and the tennis fields (`headshot`, `headshot_revision`, `tour`) are backend-owned and are OMITTED rather than null when they do not apply, so a consumer must treat an absent key and a null the same way.

label.description: Team display label as it appears on the market outcome (e.g. "Portugal").

full_name.description: The name to show for this team or competitor, the same on every surface (e.g. "UCF Knights", "Oklahoma City Thunder", "Portugal"). `label` keeps the market outcome's own spelling.

logo.description: Team crest or flag URL. Official NFL (32), WNBA (15), NBA (30), NHL (32), and MLB (30) club crests use same-origin relative paths (`/api/sports/team-logos/{league}/{abbr}.svg?v=<content hash>`); resolve relative URLs against the API origin. Vendored soccer club crests use the same path with `.png`. National teams in the registered national-team competitions use the same path with `.svg`: the official national flag, drawn whole at its own aspect. Other teams use provider artwork, including country flags for tennis players. Novelty rows, and national-team rows that are not exactly one country, retain provider artwork.

logo_mark_dark.description: True when artwork measurements show that the team mark needs a light plate on a dark background. Vendored crest verdicts are tied to the exact asset bytes; provider artwork is measured by the teams sync. Always sent; false when no current measurement marks the logo dark.

color.description: Team brand color as a hex string (provider-owned).

record.description: Win-loss record as a display string (e.g. "12-4").

score.description: Live or final score as a display string when the game is in play or settled.

headshot.description: Tennis player headshot URL, served same-origin. Present only for a tennis competitor the headshot resolver matched; absent for team sports and for unmatched players, where `logo` stays the fallback.

tour.description: Tennis tour this competitor belongs to. Present for every tennis entry whether or not `headshot` resolved, so a consumer can tell a tennis player with no photo from a non-tennis team. Absent for every other sport. Only `atp` and `wta` name a gender; the ITF World Tennis Tour runs men's and women's events and the provider does not say which, so `itf` means tennis with gender unknown.

sets.description: Per-set score cells for this side, in set order. Backend-owned: render these rather than parsing `score`. Omitted entirely when the provider score is not a structured multi-set match or could not be parsed, so an absent array and an empty one carry the same meaning.

sets_won.description: Completed sets won by this side. Present only when both sides expose the same set columns, so a partially parsed scoreline reports no tally rather than a misleading one.

headshot_revision.description: Optional monotonic photo revision for this tennis player, independent of the sports score revision. Legacy stored photos start at zero. Successful new or changed image bytes advance it; source checks and attribution changes do not. Compare only for the same tour and provider_id: a higher revision replaces the portrait, an equal revision may fill a missing portrait, and a lower revision must not replace a newer one. Absent when no photo resolved.

ranking.description: Optional latest retrieved ATP/WTA singles rank for this player. Absent for unranked, ambiguous, doubles, expired, or unavailable identities. This is not rank at match time.

logo_mark_light.description: True when artwork measurements show that the team mark disappears on a white background and needs a dark plate there: the light-background twin of logo_mark_dark. Vendored crest verdicts are tied to the exact asset bytes; provider artwork is measured on white by the teams sync. Always sent; false when no current measurement marks the logo light.

logo_mark_measured.description: True when logo_mark_dark and logo_mark_light are both measurements of this exact logo URL, so their false means the mark is legible on that background. Every vendored crest is measured; a provider logo is measured once the teams sync has scored it, usually within a few hourly cycles of first appearing. Always sent; false while the logo is not measured yet.

ScoreCell.description: One side's score in a single set. The verbatim provider text stays on the team's `score` string; this is the parsed form.

tiebreak.description: Tiebreak points won in this set. Omitted when the set had no tiebreak; absence and zero are different.

ScoreFormat.description: Shape the provider score string was parsed into. `two_side` is one aggregate per side (basketball `105-98`), `multi_set` is per-set columns (tennis `6-7(5-7), 6-0, 1-0`), `esports_series` is a maps/sets/format triplet (`000-000|2-0|Bo3`). Omitted when the score could not be parsed.

picks.description: Published Pick of the Day selections that have not been withdrawn, newest first by pick_date and then pick_rank within each product day. Withdrawn rows stay excluded after settlement.

days.description: One entry per product day that has a published pick included in the archive, newest first, in the same order as picks. Each carries that day's net units, accumulated in the same backend pass and behind the same visibility gate as hit_rate.unit_score, so both cover the same population of picks. Re-adding the day totals reproduces hit_rate.unit_score to display precision rather than bit-for-bit, since that re-associates the floating-point sum.

picks.description: Published picks on the day: wins + losses + void + pending.

wins.description: Picks on the day that resolved as a win, counted by the same pass as hit_rate.wins, so the day entries sum to the headline record.

losses.description: Picks on the day that resolved as a loss, counted by the same pass as hit_rate.losses.

void.description: Picks on the day that resolved void: the market settled with no winner, or the game was suspended or postponed and not completed within 72 hours of kickoff. A void is neither a win nor a loss and is not staked, so it enters no money figure.

pending.description: Picks on the day not yet resolved. A day whose picks are all pending is a real 0-0 day with pending > 0, not a missing record.

unit_score.description: Net units over the day's visible, valued, staked (win or loss) picks: the same population staked_usd runs over. Omitted when the day has not scored -- every pick still pending or void, or a price-gated current row -- which is not the same as a real 0.0 day.

unit_score_display.description: unit_score pre-formatted as signed units to two decimals (for example +1.24u or -2.00u), by the same formatter the per-pick unit_score_display and hit_rate.unit_score_display use. Present exactly when unit_score is; unit_score is the source value.

sweep.description: win when every decided pick on the day won, loss when every one lost, over at least three decided (win or loss) picks with nothing pending. Omitted for every other day. A void is not a result: it neither lifts a day over the floor nor spoils a sweep.

pick_rank.description: Deprecated compatibility daily release slot; use pick_id for identity and publication_order for scheduling.

published_at.description: When this selection was published, as RFC3339 UTC. Use this instant for publication feeds and timelines; pick_date is the America/New_York product day, not a publication timestamp. Absent only for historical rows whose publication instant is unknown.

category.description: Frozen canonical sport bucket (e.g. "Basketball", "MMA", or "Soccer"). Existing semantics are unchanged; presentation consumers should prefer display_category when present.

display_category.description: Frozen public presentation category. Tennis uses the provider-verified ATP or WTA tour, including Wimbledon and doubles; unknown tours retain Tennis. Every men's and women's cricket competition uses Cricket. Other sports use the curated league, esports title or soccer competition label, then the provider series name without its season year, then category when no competition is known. The canonical category and measured cohort are unchanged: an esports title still uses the pooled Esports category. Optional for mixed-version client compatibility.

image_url.description: Provider (Polymarket Gamma) market thumbnail URL (markets.image); omitted (not null) when the market has no image. Public regardless of the backed-side gate, so present for pending rows too.

pick_outcome_label.description: The backed side's outcome label. Omitted for a still-pending pick when the request is not from an authenticated Pro key.

top_grade.description: Recorded top grade on the backed side in the public V1 compatibility projection. Omitted when unavailable. Historical values remain recorded snapshots.

outcome.description: Settlement outcome of the backed side; 'pending' until the market resolves.

outcome_display.description: Pre-formatted settlement status for display: "Win" / "Loss" / "Void" / "Pending" -- the outcome enum above as a label, from the same formatter the pick payload's outcome_display uses. Convenience only; outcome is the source value.

resolved_at.description: When outcome was LAST written to a settled value (RFC3339 UTC), the same instant the commitment ledger publishes. It moves with a corrected market re-mapping an already-settled pick. Omitted (not null) for a pending pick and for a pick that settled before the instant was recorded, so absence means the instant is unknown, never that the pick is unsettled -- outcome answers that. Additive and optional for mixed-version client compatibility.

stake_usd.description: The flat stake this row was valued at, in USD: 1000 since 2026-09-22 (100 before). Every row of the record is valued at the current stake, including picks published before the change. Present exactly when return_usd is.

return_usd.description: Gross return of stake_usd on this resolved pick: a win returns stake_usd / backed_price and a loss returns 0. A loss always returns 0 (the whole stake is lost regardless of price). The operand is published beside it as backed_price on every row that carries a return, so the entry never has to be recovered by inverting this number. Omitted (not null) for a still-pending pick, for a void (the market settled with no winner, or the game was suspended or postponed and not completed within 72 hours of kickoff, so the pick is not staked) and for a resolved WIN with no frozen price (a win's payout needs the price); mirrors the backend skip-when-absent behavior and the route-client optional (non-nullable) schema.

return_per_100.description: The same return on a literal $100 (a win returns 100 / backed_price, a loss 0), kept for compatibility: the field predates stake_usd and its name promises the $100 basis. Present exactly when return_usd is.

payout_display.description: Pre-formatted return_usd as USD with cents: "$2,000.00". Present exactly when return_usd is -- it is formatted from that already-gated value -- so it is omitted for a still-pending pick, a void, an unpriced win, and any pick whose backed side is withheld. Convenience only; return_usd is the source value.

backed_price.description: Frozen price of the backed side (0..1) that return_usd and return_per_100 were computed from: on a win, stake_usd / backed_price equals return_usd. It is the Polymarket CLOB order book midpoint at release, frozen write-once at publication, not an executed fill: a buyer lifts the ask, so a subscriber's own entry is usually a little worse than this price. Present exactly when return_usd is, and on a void, which carries no return: so it is omitted for a still-pending pick, an unpriced win, and any pick whose backed side is withheld.

clv_pct.description: Closing-line value toward the backed side, computed as (close / entry - 1) * 100. Omitted when the row is gated, ineligible, or not measured.

clv_display.description: Backend-formatted signed CLV percentage, present exactly when clv_pct is present.

clv_entry_price.description: Entry operand of clv_pct: the frozen pick probability the close is compared against. It equals backed_price, which CLV eligibility requires. Present exactly when clv_pct is.

clv_close_price.description: Close operand of clv_pct: the last valid Polymarket probability before the close bound (kickoff, or the first instant the live feed reported the game in progress when that came earlier). Present exactly when clv_pct is; the close timestamp stays private.

clv_applicability.description: Whether CLV applies. A visible resolved pick published after kickoff is not_applicable.

clv_explanation.description: Backend-owned CLV text. A measured row names the entry, then the close, then the formula (close / entry - 1) x 100 and its rounded result; otherwise it gives the reason CLV does not apply or is unavailable.

clv_status.description: Exact backend CLV capture disposition for this visible row. Pending and terminal provider or quality statuses are distinguishable; capture timestamps are never serialized, while a measured row's entry and close prices are published as clv_entry_price and clv_close_price.

clv_basis.description: Backend-owned CLV evidence basis. Source-null price-match bases preserve unknown original provenance. `historical_provider_nearby_price_match` requires a matching Polymarket point within five minutes before publication.

unit_score.description: Net return for this pick in stake units (return_usd / stake_usd - 1), where one unit is one stake_usd stake; the same figure under any stake size. Omitted when the backed side is withheld or the pick is not valued.

unit_score_display.description: Backend-formatted signed unit score, present exactly when unit_score is present.

required_tier.description: The account or paid tier needed to open this unresolved rank.

backed_side_locked.description: True for an unauthorized unresolved row. Game identity, category, image, publication clock and all backed facts are omitted.

pick_id.description: Stable pick row identity as decimal text. Never use a quality rank as identity.

publication_order.description: Compatibility release slot. No quality claim; historic scheduling order is retained.

is_free_selection.description: Viewer-independent free selection designation. New rows store it explicitly; historic null storage uses the original free slot.

supersedes_pick_id.description: Deprecated (#24157): always null. No replacement lineage was ever recorded in this field; the key stays so existing V1 clients keep parsing. Identify a pick by pick_id.

wins.description: Number of decided picks that won.

losses.description: Number of decided picks that lost.

decided.description: Number of decided picks (wins + losses); excludes void and pending.

pct.description: Rolling hit rate as a percentage (wins / decided * 100, to 1 decimal); 0 when none are decided.

void.description: Number of picks that resolved void (excluded from the hit rate).

pending.description: Number of picks still pending resolution (excluded from the hit rate).

stake_usd.description: The flat stake every money figure here assumes, in USD: 1000 since 2026-09-22 (100 before). Always present.

net_profit_usd.description: Cumulative profit (USD) of a stake_usd-per-pick strategy over visible valued settled picks: a priced win pays stake_usd/backed_price - stake_usd, every visible loss pays -stake_usd independent of price. A void is not staked and adds nothing. An unpriced visible win and a current non-Insider row whose price is gated remain in wins/losses but are excluded from price-derived totals.

staked_usd.description: Total staked (USD) = stake_usd * count of visible valued settled picks: every visible loss and every priced win. Voids, unpriced wins and current non-Insider rows whose price is gated are excluded.

roi_pct.description: Return on the staked amount as a percentage (net_profit_usd / staked_usd * 100, to 1 decimal); 0 when nothing is staked.

net_profit_display.description: Pre-formatted net profit for display, e.g. "+$100" / "-$40". Whole dollars, signed, round-then-signed so a rounds-to-zero record reads "+$0" (never "-$0"). Convenience only; net_profit_usd is the source value.

roi_display.description: Pre-formatted ROI for display, e.g. "+8.3%" / "-20.0%". One decimal, signed, round-then-signed so a rounds-to-zero record reads "+0.0%" (never "-0.0%"). Convenience only; roi_pct is the source value.

win_rate_display.description: Pre-formatted win rate for display, e.g. "92.3%". One decimal, unsigned. Convenience only; pct is the source value.

unit_score.description: Cumulative net return in stake units over the same valued win/loss population as net_profit_usd.

unit_score_display.description: Backend-formatted signed cumulative unit score, for example "+1.25u". Omitted when no valued settled pick contributes to the aggregate.

clv_pending.description: Visible resolved archive rows with no CLV capture disposition yet.

clv_unavailable.description: Visible resolved archive rows with a terminal non-measured CLV disposition.

clv_state.description: Aggregate CLV state. Counts remain available for mixed measured/pending/unavailable populations.

clv_eligible.description: Visible resolved archive rows with valid basis-specific CLV entry evidence. Known-source bases require CLOB provenance; historical_provider_price_match instead requires source provenance to remain null and the latest provider p entry in the one-hour window at or before publication to match the stored display.

clv_total.description: Every visible resolved archive row, including post-kickoff picks. A price-gated current row is excluded until its backed side becomes visible.

clv_measured.description: Eligible resolved public rows with a measured Polymarket CLOB close.

clv_applicable.description: Visible resolved rows published before kickoff. This is the CLV coverage denominator.

clv_not_applicable.description: Visible resolved rows published after kickoff. These rows remain public but do not enter coverage.

clv_coverage_pct.description: Measured divided by clv_applicable as a percentage. Omitted when clv_applicable is zero.

clv_coverage_explanation.description: Backend-owned coverage count text, including the excluded post-kickoff count.

clv_avg_pct.description: Arithmetic mean of per-pick ratio CLV, (close / entry - 1) * 100. A cheap entry weighs more here than a favorite, so the headline average is clv_avg_pp; this field is kept for continuity. Suppressed until at least five measured rows exist.

clv_avg_display.description: Backend-formatted signed average CLV percentage, present when clv_avg_pct is present.

clv_avg_pp.description: Arithmetic mean of the measured closing-line move in percentage points, (close - entry) * 100, so every pick counts on the same scale. The headline CLV average. Covers the same measured rows as clv_avg_pct and is suppressed under the same five-row floor.

clv_avg_pp_display.description: Backend-formatted signed average in percentage points, for example "+0.4 pp"; a value that rounds to zero reads "0.0 pp". Present when clv_avg_pp is present.

clv_beats_close.description: Measured public rows where close is strictly greater than entry.

clv_ties.description: Measured public rows where close exactly equals entry.

series.description: Cumulative track-record series, one point per decided (win/loss) pick in ascending pick_date order (pending and void picks add no point). A non-valued decided row carries cumulative profit forward while advancing hit rate. The last point's net_profit_usd and hit_rate_pct equal the headline net_profit_usd and pct by construction. Empty when nothing is decided.

net_profit_usd.description: Running cumulative stake_usd-per-pick profit (USD) through this pick; valued losses and priced wins are booked, while a non-valued decided row carries profit forward unchanged.

hit_rate_pct.description: Running rolling hit rate (wins / decided * 100, to 1 decimal) through this pick.

PickOfTheDayLedger.description: The commitment ledger: every published pick, ascending, in the state its commitment is actually in. The counts are derived from entries in the same pass that builds it.

entries.description: One entry per published (pick_date, pick_rank), ascending by pick_date then pick_rank.

entry_count.description: Number of entries, all states included.

sealed_count.description: Entries committed to and not yet settled.

opened_count.description: Entries committed to and verifiable now.

uncommitted_count.description: Entries carrying no commitment, so provable by nothing: the honest size of the unprovable part of the record. It only stops growing; no pick is ever retro-sealed.

PickOfTheDayLedgerEntry.description: One ledger entry. Read `state` to know which shape you have; the three are disjoint.

PickOfTheDayLedgerSealedEntry.description: An unresolved published pick. Carries only date, rank, hash, algorithm, seal instant and permalink. Kickoff and game identity are withheld; seal time remains public commitment provenance.

pick_date.description: ET product day the pick belongs to (YYYY-MM-DD).

pick_rank.description: Deprecated compatibility daily release slot; use pick_id for identity and publication_order for scheduling.

commitment_hash.description: sha256(canonical_json(payload) || nonce), lowercase hex, no 0x prefix. Publishable the moment the pick releases: without the nonce it is not invertible.

commitment_algo.description: The construction the hash was taken with, stated in the response so a verifier never has to guess the serialization.

sealed_at.description: When the hash was frozen. Always strictly before kickoff: a pick that reaches kickoff unsealed stays unsealed forever, because a seal written after the game started would be a backdated proof.

pick_id.description: Stable pick row identity as decimal text. Never use a quality rank as identity.

publication_order.description: Compatibility release slot. No quality claim; historic scheduling order is retained.

is_free_selection.description: Viewer-independent free selection designation. New rows store it explicitly; historic null storage uses the original free slot.

supersedes_pick_id.description: Deprecated (#24157): always null. No replacement lineage was ever recorded in this field; the key stays so existing V1 clients keep parsing. Identify a pick by pick_id.

commitment_version.description: Explicit proof provenance: 1 retains historic eight-field canonical JSON; 2 binds stable pick_id and version without pick_rank.

PickOfTheDayLedgerOpenedEntry.description: A settled pick whose commitment is open: the nonce plus the exact payload the hash was taken over. Concatenate the payload bytes as received with the decoded nonce and sha256 them to reproduce commitment_hash.

pick_date.description: ET product day the pick belongs to (YYYY-MM-DD).

pick_rank.description: Deprecated compatibility daily release slot; use pick_id for identity and publication_order for scheduling.

commitment_hash.description: sha256(canonical_json(payload) || nonce), lowercase hex, no 0x prefix. Publishable the moment the pick releases: without the nonce it is not invertible.

commitment_nonce.description: The 32-byte nonce the hash was taken over, lowercase hex, no 0x prefix. Secret while the pick is live: a pick payload is low entropy, so a published nonce on a live pick would hand out the backed side.

commitment_algo.description: The construction the hash was taken with, stated in the response so a verifier never has to guess the serialization.

sealed_at.description: When the hash was frozen. Always strictly before kickoff: a pick that reaches kickoff unsealed stays unsealed forever, because a seal written after the game started would be a backdated proof.

resolved_at.description: When outcome was LAST written to a settled value, or null when that instant is unknown. It moves with a corrected market re-mapping an already-settled pick, while commitment_hash stays untouched -- which is how a mirror that keeps history sees a correction.

kickoff.description: The frozen provider kickoff in the canonical payload form: whole seconds, UTC, literal Z. This exact string reappears inside payload.kickoff when the pick opens.

outcome.description: How the pick settled. Never pending: a pending pick is a sealed entry.

withdrawal_reason.description: Why the site withdrew this pick from its track record, or null when the pick counts. provider_game_cancelled: Polymarket marked the game Cancelled while the pick was pending. published_after_kickoff: the pick was published at or after its game started, including a suspended match that resumed later, so it was never a pre-game pick; this can be set after the pick settled. A withdrawn pick keeps its commitment and its real outcome here, but the site's record leaves it out of every count and money figure. Not part of the hashed payload, so it never moves commitment_hash.

category.description: Frozen canonical sport bucket (for example Basketball or MMA), not the exact public league identity; the archive owns that.

pick_id.description: Stable pick row identity as decimal text. Never use a quality rank as identity.

publication_order.description: Compatibility release slot. No quality claim; historic scheduling order is retained.

is_free_selection.description: Viewer-independent free selection designation. New rows store it explicitly; historic null storage uses the original free slot.

supersedes_pick_id.description: Deprecated (#24157): always null. No replacement lineage was ever recorded in this field; the key stays so existing V1 clients keep parsing. Identify a pick by pick_id.

commitment_version.description: Explicit proof provenance: 1 retains historic eight-field canonical JSON; 2 binds stable pick_id and version without pick_rank.

PickOfTheDayLedgerUncommittedEntry.description: A pick without a commitment, retained so the record cannot omit unprovable entries. Unresolved entries omit game identity; once resolved, matchup, category and payload become public. Existing opened canonical payload bytes and hashes are unchanged.

pick_date.description: ET product day the pick belongs to (YYYY-MM-DD).

pick_rank.description: Deprecated compatibility daily release slot; use pick_id for identity and publication_order for scheduling.

pre_commitment.description: Always true: this pick has no commitment and never will.

outcome.description: How the pick settled, or pending.

withdrawal_reason.description: Omitted while the pick is pending; once it settles, why the site withdrew it from its track record, or null when the pick counts. provider_game_cancelled: Polymarket marked the game Cancelled while the pick was pending. published_after_kickoff: the pick was published at or after its game started, including a suspended match that resumed later, so it was never a pre-game pick; this can be set after the pick settled. A withdrawn pick stays here with its real outcome, but the site's record leaves it out of every count and money figure.

category.description: Frozen canonical sport bucket (for example Basketball or MMA), not the exact public league identity; the archive owns that.

resolved_at.description: When outcome was LAST written to a settled value, or null when that instant is unknown. It moves with a corrected market re-mapping an already-settled pick, while commitment_hash stays untouched -- which is how a mirror that keeps history sees a correction.

payload.description: The pick's market, side and price once it has settled; null while it is pending, and null for a settled pick whose stored row lacks one of these columns. Not hashed: nothing was committed over these values, which is what pre_commitment: true says.

pick_id.description: Stable pick row identity as decimal text. Never use a quality rank as identity.

publication_order.description: Compatibility release slot. No quality claim; historic scheduling order is retained.

is_free_selection.description: Viewer-independent free selection designation. New rows store it explicitly; historic null storage uses the original free slot.

supersedes_pick_id.description: Deprecated (#24157): always null. No replacement lineage was ever recorded in this field; the key stays so existing V1 clients keep parsing. Identify a pick by pick_id.

PickOfTheDayCommitmentPayload.description: Select using the entry commitment_version, never implicit payload shape. All historic v1 hashes remain unchanged.

PickOfTheDayUncommittedPayload.description: A settled uncommitted pick's market, side and price. The same eight fields as PickOfTheDayCommitmentPayload, in the same key order, so a settled pick's side and price sit under payload whatever the entry's state. It is NOT a commitment: no hash was taken over it before the game, and it proves nothing about when the pick was made.

backed_price.description: Frozen pre-game price of the backed side, 0..1, as the plain decimal text of the stored NUMERIC at full stored precision, trailing zeros included -- rendered exactly as the commitment payload renders it.

condition_id.description: Provider condition id of the backed market.

kickoff.description: Frozen provider kickoff, UTC, literal Z; null when no kickoff was frozen. Whole seconds render exactly as the commitment payload does; a sub-second instant keeps its fraction rather than being truncated, since nothing here is hashed.

pick_outcome_index.description: Index of the backed outcome within the market.

pick_outcome_label.description: Frozen display label of the backed outcome.

streak_tier.description: Hot-streak tier (trailing-7d cross-sectional percentile); a separate axis from the all-time grade. Omitted when there is no recent activity.

pnl.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was Polymarket's all-time leaderboard P&L, which covered every Polymarket market of the wallet, and wallet figures cover sports and esports markets only (#29971). Read in_scope.realized_pnl.

realized_pnl.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was native Polymarket realized P&L over every Polymarket market of the wallet, and wallet figures cover sports and esports markets only (#29971). Read in_scope.realized_pnl.

pnl_correction.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was the neg-risk conversion correction to the wallet-wide realized_pnl (#29971). Its sports and esports part is inside in_scope.realized_pnl.

volume.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was full-history USD cash volume over every Polymarket market of the wallet, and wallet figures cover sports and esports markets only (#29971).

markets_traded.description: Sports and esports markets on the wallet's record, the same count as in_scope.markets. Since 2026-10-27 (#29971); before, it counted every Polymarket market. Sent exactly when in_scope is.

win_rate.description: The wallet's sports and esports win rate, in_scope.win_rate rounded to four places. Since 2026-10-27 (#29971); before, it covered every Polymarket market. ?category= decides WHICH wallets are listed (the wallet must be ranked in that category); it does not rescope this field. For a per-category record use GET /api/v1/trader/{address}/categories. Omitted when in_scope is omitted or has no win rate.

in_scope.description: Additive (#27859): the wallet's sports and esports record, the same object as GET /api/v1/trader/{address} pnl.in_scope, as of the leaderboard's last refresh. The 0xinsider leaderboard page shows and sorts by in_scope.realized_pnl and in_scope.win_rate. Omitted until 0xinsider has computed the wallet's record; absent means not computed yet, never zero.

price_edge.description: Additive (#32270): the wallet's edge over the price paid on its sports and esports markets, the figures the 0xinsider leaderboard page's Edge column states for the row. sort=edge orders by price_edge.edge. Omitted when the wallet has no settled sports or esports market of $20 or more at a known entry price.

strategy_type.description: Observed trading style identifier. New rows use two_sided, category_focused, high_activity, diversified, mixed, or unclassified, counted over the wallet's sports and esports markets only. Historical identifiers remain readable during normal reclassification; style does not predict skill or intent.

last_active.description: When the wallet last traded: its most recent recorded trade, as of the leaderboard row's last refresh, which re-reads it hourly, so a new trade can take about an hour to show. It agrees with the activity filter: every wallet listed under activity=inactive last traded more than 30 days ago. Since 2026-11-02 (#32322); before, it carried the time 0xinsider last synced the wallet, usually within the past week whether or not the wallet traded. Omitted when the wallet has no recorded trade.

LeaderboardPriceEdge.description: Edge over the price paid (#32270): how often the side a wallet bought won, minus the average price it paid, over its settled sports and esports markets of $20 or more at a known entry price. Probabilities throughout: edge 0.12 is 12 percentage points. A wallet buying at 99 cents that wins every market has an edge of about 0.01. A market bought on both sides counts by its shares: the winning side's share of the shares bought is its hit, the cost over those shares its price.

markets.description: Settled sports and esports markets of $20 or more at a known entry price that the edge is measured over.

hit_rate.description: Share of those markets whose bought side won, 0-1.

edge.description: hit_rate minus avg_price, full precision. The value sort=edge orders by.

status.description: Whether the edge ranks. ranked: at least 30 such markets, and the share of the decided ones that made money at settlement within 10 points of the win rate over the same markets. too_few_markets: fewer than 30. sample_mismatch: that share is more than 10 points away, so these markets do not describe the wallet's record. Only a ranked edge with no hold orders on sort=edge.

hold.description: Why the leaderboard does not rank a ranked edge. record_incomplete: the wallet's stored sports and esports record shows more profit than Polymarket reports for it, so some losing markets are likely missing. Omitted when nothing holds the edge, and always omitted unless status is ranked.

platform.description: Provider platform. Always polymarket, or null when the row carries no stored value.

status.description: closed once Polymarket has closed trading or the market has resolved; active otherwise. The same rule labels a market on markets/search, markets/explore and market/{condition_id}/snapshot.

url_slug.description: First-party market page slug used for internal links.

platform.description: Provider platform. Always polymarket, or null when the row carries no stored value.

status.description: closed once Polymarket has closed trading or the market has resolved; active otherwise. The same rule labels a market on markets/search, markets/explore and market/{condition_id}/snapshot.

volume.description: Polymarket's traded-volume figure for the market, as last stored: cumulative taker volume in shares, each counted at its $1 settlement value, not the cash that changed hands (100 shares bought at $0.40 add 100, not 40). It can lag Polymarket's current figure. sort=volume orders by it. Null when unavailable.

large_trade_count.description: Canonical key since #16304 (Polymarket's noun is large trade); whale_trade_count is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

whale_trade_count.description: Deprecated spelling of large_trade_count, emitted beside it with the same value. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read large_trade_count.

large_trade_distinct_wallets.description: Canonical key since #16304; whale_distinct_wallets is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

whale_distinct_wallets.description: Deprecated spelling of large_trade_distinct_wallets, emitted beside it with the same value. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read large_trade_distinct_wallets.

large_trade_total_usd.description: Canonical key since #16304; whale_total_usd is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

whale_total_usd.description: Deprecated spelling of large_trade_total_usd, emitted beside it with the same value. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read large_trade_total_usd.

large_trade_last_at.description: Canonical key since #16304; whale_last_trade_at is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

whale_last_trade_at.description: Deprecated spelling of large_trade_last_at, emitted beside it with the same value. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read large_trade_last_at.

token_id_yes.description: The Polymarket CLOB token id (ERC1155 asset id, decimal string) for the YES outcome; null when unavailable (e.g. unsynced markets).

token_id_no.description: The Polymarket CLOB token id (ERC1155 asset id, decimal string) for the NO outcome; null when unavailable (e.g. unsynced markets).

smart_label.description: The outcome graded money leans toward RELATIVE TO THE PRICE: named only when the graded money's share of a side diverges from that side's price-implied share by at least 10 points, with at least $500 on the leaning side and outside the crowded-side guard. Null when the money sits with the price (no lean), when there is no graded money, or when the price is unavailable. The same rule as the market page.

sharp_money_as_of.description: When the oldest stored smart-money wallet behind this split (smart_score, smart_count and smart_label) last finished syncing. Graded wallets sync on different schedules, so this is often hours or days ago. Some holdings in the split can come from a Polymarket holder read cached for up to 3 minutes, which this time does not describe. Null when there is no split or a wallet's sync time is unknown.

outcome_yes_label.description: Display label for the YES/outcome_index=0 side, enriched from provider outcome metadata when available.

outcome_no_label.description: Display label for the NO/outcome_index=1 side, enriched from provider outcome metadata when available.

outcome_yes_provider_id.description: Provider-owned YES/outcome_index=0 identifier when available for trade-ticket wiring.

outcome_no_provider_id.description: Provider-owned NO/outcome_index=1 identifier when available for trade-ticket wiring.

discover_score.description: Backend-owned deterministic market discovery score used by the hot sort.

large_trade_signal.description: Canonical key since #16304; whale_signal is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

whale_signal.description: Deprecated spelling of large_trade_signal, emitted beside it with the same value. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read large_trade_signal.

sharp_money_signal.description: Canonical key since #16308; smart_money_signal is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

smart_money_signal.description: Deprecated spelling of sharp_money_signal; emitted beside it with the same value. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read sharp_money_signal.

platform.description: Provider platform. Always polymarket, or null when the row carries no stored value.

markets.description: Markets in the event cluster, ranked by volume with condition_id as the tie-breaker. The selected representative is retained within the 12-market cap.

rep_volume.description: The volume of the group's highest-volume market, which is markets[0]: the same figure as that market's volume, Polymarket's cumulative taker volume in shares rather than cash. Null when unavailable.

rep_large_trades.description: Canonical key since #16304; rep_whales is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

rep_whales.description: Deprecated spelling of rep_large_trades, emitted beside it with the same value. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read rep_large_trades.

id.description: Composite `pos_<wallet>:<condition_id>:<outcome_index>`, the same id `GET /api/v1/positions` gives this leg.

name.description: Polymarket's public display name from the same holder snapshot; null for a private wallet, which the provider redacts at the source.

side.description: The outcome this wallet nets to. A wallet holding both outcomes is listed once, on its net side; see `other_outcome_shares`.

token_id.description: Polymarket CLOB token id (ERC1155 asset id, decimal string) for `side`; null when the market has no stored token id.

grade.description: All-time trader grade. This route lists the S/A/B cohort only, the same cohort a Pick of the Day roster lists.

shares.description: Shares held on `side`, from the complete provider scan.

current_value_usd.description: Polymarket's own currentValue for this leg, in USD. Null when the snapshot predates the value map.

other_outcome_shares.description: Shares on the other outcome when the wallet holds both. Absent when the wallet is one-sided.

last_traded_at.description: The wallet's last recorded trade anywhere, null when unknown.

category_win_rate.description: This wallet's win rate in the market's canonical category (`market.category`): the share of its settled markets in that category (it closed its position by selling out, or the market resolved) whose realized P&L closed positive, as a 0..1 fraction. Present only with `category_win_rate_status` = `measured`. The same read `GET /api/v1/trader/{address}/categories` serves per wallet.

wins.description: Settled markets in the category that this wallet closed with a profit.

decided.description: Settled markets in the category that this wallet closed with a profit or a loss. A market resolved at zero realized P&L is in neither count.

category_win_record.description: The two counts `category_win_rate` is the ratio of, from the same row: `wins / decided` equals the rate. Every settled Polymarket market the wallet traded (it closed its position by selling out, or the market resolved) in the market's canonical category, at any position size, rebuilt daily. Present only with `category_win_rate_status` = `measured`.

category_avg_price.description: The wallet's average entry price in the market's canonical category, as a 0..1 fraction of $1 (0.98 is 98 cents). Its sample is the wallet's markets in that category that resolved to a winning side, of $20 or more where it bought one side at a known price, so it can differ from the `category_win_record` sample. A wallet that buys near-certain outcomes wins almost every time, so read the win rate beside this price. Present only with `category_win_rate_status` = `measured`, and only when that sample has at least 5 markets. When `category_win_rate_game` is present the price is still the whole `category` bucket's: this field has no per-game or per-league price. Absent otherwise and on payloads predating the field.

category_win_rate_game.description: Where `category_win_rate` and `category_win_record` were measured: for an esports market the game (`LoL`, `CS2`, `Dota 2`, `Valorant`, `Call of Duty`, `Honor of Kings`, `Mobile Legends: Bang Bang`, `Overwatch`, `Rainbow Six Siege`, `Rocket League` or `StarCraft II`), and for a market in a registered league that league, by the name Pick of the Day uses for it (`NBA`, `NFL`, `NHL`, `MLB`, `UFC`, `ATP`, `WTA`, `LaLiga`, `Premier League`, `Serie A`, `UEFA Champions League`, `MLS` and the other registered leagues). Present only when the wallet's record there clears the 5-settled-market floor, in which case the rate and record are the game's or league's rather than the whole `category` bucket's. Absent when the rate is the bucket's (the wallet's history there is under the floor, or the competition is not a registered league), on every other market, and beside every non-measured status. Label the rate with this when present and with the market's `category` otherwise.

category_win_rate_status.description: Why `category_win_rate` is present or absent: `measured` (rate present), `not_enough_data` (under the floor of 5 decided markets in the category), or `unavailable` (the market has no canonical category, or the read failed; retry later). Never `untracked`: this route lists S, A and B wallets only, all on file. Always present on this route.

wallet_age_days.description: Whole days since this wallet's first trade, rounded down (3.6 days reads 3), so it changes once a day, not on every request. The five badge fields are present together, only for a wallet that draws at least one badge.

is_new_wallet.description: True when the wallet's first trade was under 30 days ago.

markets_traded.description: Distinct markets the wallet has traded.

is_bot.description: True when the wallet is flagged as automated.

x_username.description: The wallet's X handle without the @, when linked.

id.description: `mkt_`-prefixed market id.

category.description: The canonical category bucket `category_win_rate` is measured in.

status.description: A settled market's roster is whatever the provider still lists as open; it empties as holders redeem.

source.description: `cached`: the shared holder snapshot, at most 180 s old at compute time. `live`: the provider answered a fresh complete walk for this compute.

complete.description: Always true on a served roster. An incomplete or unstable scan is a 503, never a partial list.

fetched_at.description: When the provider walk that produced the holder population finished.

wallet_count.description: Every distinct wallet the complete walk saw with open shares, graded or not. The roster lists the graded S/A/B subset.

MarketHoldersSideGradeUsd.description: Polymarket currentValue in USD per grade on one side, over the same wallets as that side's usd total. Each value is rounded to the cent after summing, so s + a + b can differ from the side total by up to 2 cents.

s.description: USD held by S-grade wallets netting this side.

a.description: USD held by A-grade wallets netting this side.

b.description: USD held by B-grade wallets netting this side.

MarketHoldersTotals.description: Roster totals BEFORE any `outcome` or `min_grade` filter, so a page always knows the whole market it was cut from.

graded_count.description: Distinct graded wallets with net exposure; a two-sided wallet counts once.

yes_usd.description: Polymarket currentValue summed over the graded wallets netting YES.

no_usd.description: Polymarket currentValue summed over the graded wallets netting NO.

yes_grade_usd.description: yes_usd split by grade: where the S, A and B money on YES sits.

no_grade_usd.description: no_usd split by grade: where the S, A and B money on NO sits.

rank.description: 1-based position on this outcome, by shares.

name.description: The wallet's display name; null when it shows none.

grade.description: All-time trader grade, S to F. Null for a wallet 0xinsider has not graded: this route lists every holder whatever its grade.

current_value_usd.description: Polymarket's current value of this position, in USD. Null when the provider served none.

avg_entry_price.description: Average price paid for the shares still held, as a 0..1 fraction of $1. Null when the provider served none.

other_outcome_shares.description: Shares on the other outcome when the wallet holds both; the wallet is then listed on both sides. Absent when it is one-sided.

position_realized_pnl.description: Polymarket's realized P&L of this position (sells and redemptions), in USD. Null when the provider served no economics for the row.

position_unrealized_pnl.description: Polymarket's mark-to-market P&L of the shares still held, in USD. On a resolved market the mark is the settlement price.

in_scope_realized_pnl.description: The wallet's realized P&L on sports and esports markets, in USD, the figure on its 0xinsider profile. Null until 0xinsider has computed the record, never 0 in its place, and null for every row when `profiles_status` is `unavailable`.

in_scope_volume.description: The wallet's volume traded on sports and esports markets, in USD. Null under the same rule as `in_scope_realized_pnl`.

strategy_type.description: The wallet's stored trading-style label (see Wallet trading styles); null when it has none.

last_traded_at.description: The wallet's last recorded trade anywhere, null when unknown.

category_win_rate.description: This wallet's win rate in the market's canonical category (`market.category`): the share of its settled markets in that category (it closed its position by selling out, or the market resolved) whose realized P&L closed positive, as a 0..1 fraction. Present only with `category_win_rate_status` = `measured`. The same read `GET /api/v1/trader/{address}/categories` serves per wallet.

wins.description: Settled markets in the category that this wallet closed with a profit.

decided.description: Settled markets in the category that this wallet closed with a profit or a loss. A market resolved at zero realized P&L is in neither count.

wallet_age_days.description: Whole days since this wallet's first trade, rounded down (3.6 days reads 3), so it changes once a day, not on every request. The five badge fields are present together, only for a wallet that draws at least one badge.

is_new_wallet.description: True when the wallet's first trade was under 30 days ago.

markets_traded.description: Distinct markets the wallet has traded.

is_bot.description: True when the wallet is flagged as automated.

x_username.description: The wallet's X handle without the @, when linked.

yes.description: The largest YES holders, by shares, up to `limit`.

no.description: The largest NO holders, by shares, up to `limit`.

profiles_status.description: `unavailable` when the wallet record read failed: `in_scope_realized_pnl`, `in_scope_volume` and `strategy_type` are then null for every row because they were not read, not because they are unknown.

category_records_as_of.description: When the daily pass behind the rows' category win records began. Absent when the market has no category or the read answered no row.

computed_at.description: When this holder sample was built.

positions_as_of.description: When Polymarket's holder board behind this sample was fetched: up to 120 s before `computed_at` on an open market. Absent on a resolved market, whose sample reads no live board, and when the fetch stamp could not be read.

yes_count.description: Holders in the YES sample, before `limit`. Equal to `sample_cap` means that many or more.

no_count.description: Holders in the NO sample, before `limit`.

yes_shares.description: Shares summed over the YES sample.

no_shares.description: Shares summed over the NO sample.

sample_cap.description: The most holders the sample keeps per outcome (100).

platform.description: Provider platform. Always polymarket, or null when the row carries no stored value.

sharp_money.description: Outcome-aware flow from all tracked whale trades in the window, without a grade filter. BUY YES and SELL NO add net exposure; BUY NO and SELL YES subtract it. Gross buy/sell volumes count both outcomes. Top positions are separately graded. Direction uses unrounded net: negative is NO, otherwise YES; the zero tie-break is not conviction. volume_24h_as_of.description: When 0xinsider read volume_24h_usd from Polymarket; the figure covers the 24 hours before this time. Null exactly when volume_24h_usd is null.

last_price.description: Always null. Polymarket snapshot prices come from outcome top-of-book midpoints.

live_score.description: Live-score period and elapsed may be omitted when unavailable (older responses use null). A score entry may omit full_name when it equals team; fall back to team. For live esports, scores[].map_score retains an available pair through an update omitting both sides only within the same live map, series format and series totals. Map changes and final state follow current provider updates; absent detail remains unavailable. Optional tennis_points supplies independently sourced current-game points and serving side; absence means unavailable. Compatible unexpired tennis_points survives temporary supplemental snapshot unavailability or contention; expiry and set/game mismatch still clear it.

live_sports.description: Freshness requires the dedicated two-second post-publication marker to match the retained vintage and non-invalidated data timestamp; timestamp presence alone is insufficient. as_of records compute start, so stale_after_s is omitted rather than implying as_of plus two seconds. Missing membership is not_live only in a fresh source; stale membership remains stale and unreadable source data is unavailable. Repeated lookups reuse the shared payload and typed index for an unchanged generation.

trust.description: Price and spread trust metadata. Present only when expand=trust or expand[]=trust is requested.

id.description: Prefixed ID (rf_...).

code.description: FROZEN: an existing value never changes meaning. request_timeout (408, #16146) was added the way insufficient_scope was: the handler did not answer inside the server's 30-second timeout. Retry-After and retry_at ride on it only for a safe method (GET, HEAD); a timed-out mutation may have completed, so check its state and reuse its Idempotency-Key.

retry_at.description: The recommended next retry instant (RFC3339). Present on every retryable error (reason=pick_not_released, code=rate_limited including reason=monthly_quota_exceeded, code=rate_limit_unavailable, reason=read_model_warming) and omitted otherwise. Always in the future. For pick_not_released, the recommendation is advisory and can change before a pick becomes available. Schedule the next request from the returned value instead of inferring a release schedule or polling. Prefer Retry-After for the duration because it is immune to client clock skew.

reason.description: ADDITIVE (#7209). The specific, actionable cause behind `code`, when there is one more specific than the code itself. `code` keeps its published values, so existing clients are unaffected; new clients branch on `reason`. Omitted when the code already says everything we know. pick_not_released: no Pick of the Day is published for the current product day; schedule one request against retry_at instead of polling. unknown_endpoint: the PATH is not a route on this API -- read GET /api/v1, do not retry. trader_not_tracked: the wallet is real and the URL is right, but the trader is not on the warm sync tier (the wallets we sync most often) -- stop asking for this wallet. market_out_of_scope (404 not_found, #27303): the market or event is real and the URL is right, but 0xinsider serves sports and esports markets only -- stop asking for this market; neither a retry nor another URL for it can succeed. cursor_expired: pagination went stale mid-walk -- re-request the first page and continue. read_model_warming: the requested endpoint cannot serve its read model yet; exact causes are endpoint-specific and can include a cold or contended refresh or a dependency that prevented refresh. database_unavailable: the API's database or its connection pool is temporarily unreachable (a connection-class failure, not a query fault); code stays rate_limit_unavailable, nothing is rate-limited, retry after Retry-After / retry_at. idempotency_in_progress: retain the exact Idempotency-Key and request body, then retry shortly. webhook_delivery_in_progress: retry the URL or signing-secret configuration change after the destination's active request completes. request_accounting_unavailable: accounting capacity is unavailable before the handler executes; retry after Retry-After / retry_at. sandbox_api_key: the credential is a sandbox key (oxi_sk_test_) from POST /api/v1/agents/register, which only the sandbox server accepts -- call the sandbox base URL with it, or get a live key or OAuth access token; do not retry it here. api_key_in_query: the key was sent as a ?token= query parameter, which no route reads because URLs land in logs and history; the key itself was not checked -- resend it as Authorization: Bearer. subscription_inactive: the key is valid but the account's Pro subscription has lapsed (402 subscription_required); permanent until a person reactivates at https://0xinsider.com/billing, which the message names -- stop retrying on a schedule and surface the link. The key owner is emailed once per lapse. monthly_quota_exceeded: the account has used the requests its plan includes for the UTC calendar month (429 rate_limited); retry_at and Retry-After name the first of next month, the only retry that can succeed, and the message names https://0xinsider.com/developers, where pay as you go for requests over the quota is turned on. The X-Monthly-Quota-Limit, X-Monthly-Quota-Remaining and X-Monthly-Quota-Reset headers on every authenticated response say how close the account is. invalid_query, invalid_path, invalid_body (400 bad_request, #16146): a query parameter, a path segment or the JSON body did not parse or does not fit the route's schema, so no handler ran; param names the field when the parser named one (a query key, a path segment, a JSON path such as traders[0], or body); fix the request, never retry it as sent. unsupported_media_type (415 bad_request, param content-type): send the body with Content-Type: application/json. payload_too_large (413 bad_request, param body): the body is over 1048576 bytes. method_not_allowed (405 bad_request): the path is a route but not with this method; the Allow header names the methods it serves. ip_rate_limited (429 rate_limited, #16380): the per-address budget every caller behind one IP shares, counted before authentication, is spent; not the key's own window, and the RateLimit-* headers describe that bucket. ip_throttled (429 rate_limited): the address is in a cooldown after sustained over-limit traffic; Retry-After is minutes to days, and a request before it does not shorten the cooldown. cold_read_limited (429 rate_limited, #28752): the account has used its share of cold reads on GET /api/v1/market/{condition_id}/holders, requests for a market whose roster is not cached, each of which walks Polymarket (6 a minute, in bursts of up to 400); not the per-minute window, so a cached market still answers, and the next cold read is admitted at Retry-After. max_plan_required (403 forbidden, #23085): the key is valid and its account is on Pro, but the route is part of Max (GET /api/v1/edge-hunter); every Pro route keeps working with the same key, so do not disable it. The message names https://0xinsider.com/pricing, where the account upgrades; a retry never clears it. endpoint_retired (410): this legacy sports endpoint no longer serves data. Migrate to GET /api/v1/edge-hunter; retrying the retired path cannot succeed.

limit.description: The batch item budget per minute for the caller's plan: 2500 item units on Pro, 5000 on Max. The same number X-Batch-RateLimit-Limit reports.

reset.description: Unix timestamp when the batch item window resets.

request_id.description: Unique request ID (req_ prefix). The same value as the X-Request-Id response header, the request's usage accounting row and its log lines.

request_cost.description: Number of batch item units reserved before execution.

index.description: Zero-based request index. Duplicate inputs keep separate result rows.
