version.description: Immutable content version for a durable report identity; 0 for an ephemeral explicit weekly from/to range.

storage.description: durable for canonical daily, ISO-week, and monthly snapshot identities; ephemeral for explicit weekly from/to ranges, which are recomputed within a bounded 31-day window and never persisted.

status.description: final only for a body whose source read started at or after final_after (the UTC close of the range plus the whale-trade ingestion budget). rolling for a live range and for a closed range still inside that budget: such a body refreshes every five minutes, is rebuilt once after final_after, and is then frozen. Before 2026-09-22 a closed range read final from the calendar alone, even for a body built before the range ended (#16225).

mutable_until.description: For a rolling body, the UTC date on which a final body can first be built (the date of final_after); null once final.

period_closed.description: Whether the source range has ended on the UTC calendar. Closing is not finality: a closed range is rolling until final_after.

final_after.description: The instant a source read must start at or after to produce a final body: the range's UTC close plus 7,530 s, the whale-trade ingestion budget (p95 block lag gate plus the projection retry budget).

source_read_started_at.description: When this body's source read started, the clock finality is judged on. null for a body stored before that clock was recorded.

status.description: complete only on a final body (snapshot.status final). partial for a live range and for a closed range whose body was read before final_after; reason says which. empty when the range has no whale activity.

covered_days_with_large_trade_activity.description: Canonical key since #16304; covered_days_with_whale_activity is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

covered_days_with_whale_activity.description: Deprecated spelling of covered_days_with_large_trade_activity, emitted beside it with the same value. Sunset 2027-02-01 (#29352): removed from V1 on that date; read covered_days_with_large_trade_activity.

whale_volume_source.description: Where the whale volume in this report is read from: the column name `whale_alerts.usdc_notional_num`, followed in parentheses by the reconciliation note the server attaches to it. The server has always sent the note with the name, so this is not a bare constant; match on the prefix, not the whole string.

total_large_trades.description: Canonical key since #16304; total_whale_trades is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

total_large_trade_volume.description: Canonical key since #16304; total_whale_volume is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

top_large_trades.description: Canonical key since #16304; top_whale_trades is its deprecated spelling, emitted beside it with the same value until its sunset on 2027-02-01 (#29352).

outcome.description: Provider outcome label for the traded side.

side.description: Trade direction (BUY or SELL), not the outcome side.

token_id.description: The Polymarket CLOB token id (ERC1155 asset id, decimal string) for the traded outcome; null when unavailable (e.g. unsynced markets).

id.description: Whale trade id.

platform.description: Always polymarket, or null when the row carries no stored value.

pseudonym.description: Trader pseudonym, when no display name is known.

outcome.description: Provider outcome label for the traded side.

side.description: Trade direction (BUY or SELL), not the outcome side.

token_id.description: The Polymarket CLOB token id (ERC1155 asset id, decimal string) for the traded outcome; null when unavailable (e.g. unsynced markets).

id.description: Whale trade id.

platform.description: Always polymarket, or null when the row carries no stored value.

pseudonym.description: Trader pseudonym, when no display name is known.

grade_distribution.description: Counts of current grades for distinct Polymarket traders with at least one whale alert in the report's source date range. The grade is the current projection at snapshot materialization time, not a historical grade at trade time. Traders without a current ranking projection are omitted; a null grade entry means the active trader's current grade is unavailable.

market_scope.description: Which markets the report counts. sports_and_esports for a period that ends on or after 2026-10-21: totals, categories, top trades and the grade cohort cover sports and esports markets only. all_markets for an earlier period, whose stored report keeps every Polymarket market it published.

product_scope.description: The markets the export file's trades and markets sections hold: sports and esports markets only. counts.exported_markets, counts.estimated_trade_rows, counts.estimated_size_mb, reconciliation.exported_market_cost_basis and source_range.latest_trade_at and latest_market_activity_at describe those markets, and reconciliation.exported_activity_volume is the cash the wallet traded in sports and esports markets. source_range.first_pnl_date, last_pnl_date and pnl_series_status and counts.pnl_days describe the file's pnl section, the wallet's sports and esports realized P&L by day. completeness.sync_coverage is the wallet's stored markets (its sports and esports markets since 2026-10-27, #29366) plus the markets of other categories whose rows were deleted and counted (position_summary.markets_pruned on the context) and those first traded since 2026-10-26, which are not stored and are counted as the wallet syncs (position_summary.markets_unstored, #30165) and its combo markets, which Polymarket counts and no position read lists (position_summary.markets_combo, #30218), over Polymarket's count of every market it traded: both sides count every category, so a fully synced wallet reads 1.0 and complete. A wallet with nothing stored and no pnl day is empty whatever its coverage.

first_pnl_date.description: The first UTC day in the export file's pnl section, the wallet's sports and esports realized P&L by day: the file's export_metadata.pnl_date_from. Null when that section has no day, including while pnl_series_status is pending.

last_pnl_date.description: The last UTC day in the export file's pnl section: the file's export_metadata.pnl_date_to. Null when that section has no day.

pnl_series_status.description: Whether the export file's pnl section holds the wallet's sports and esports day series, the file's export_metadata.pnl_series_status. pending means 0xinsider has not computed the series yet: the dates are null and counts.pnl_days is 0, which then never means the wallet has no day. A wallet that traded no sports or esports market is ready with null dates and counts.pnl_days 0: it never gets a series, and with nothing stored completeness.status is empty (since 2026-10-29, #30620, #30657).

latest_trade_at.description: The latest trade in the wallet's sports and esports markets. Null when it has none.

latest_market_activity_at.description: Same instant as latest_trade_at: the latest activity of the markets the export holds.

provider_lifetime_volume.description: Deprecated (#30499): always null since 2026-10-29. It held Polymarket's volume across every market of the wallet, which reconciles nothing against the sports and esports exported_activity_volume; the key stays so existing V1 clients keep parsing. Read exported_activity_volume for the wallet's sports and esports volume.

exported_activity_volume.description: Volume in USD, buys and sells, in sports and esports markets, each fill's size times its price with fees excluded, summed over the wallet's stored daily volume rows (from the fills 0xinsider stores for the wallet): the export file's summary.volume_reconciliation.exported_activity_volume, not the sum of its pnl[].total_volume, which is null on a day the trade rollups do not cover. Never Polymarket's share count. Null when any of those rows has no volume: a sum over the other days would be a partial subtotal.

exported_market_cost_basis.description: Cost basis in USD summed over the wallet's sports and esports markets, the markets section of the export.

provider_activity_volume_gap.description: Always null. provider_lifetime_volume covered every market and exported_activity_volume sports and esports markets only, so their difference measured nothing; the field stays so existing clients keep parsing the object.

activity_volume_coverage.description: Always null, for the same reason as provider_activity_volume_gap.

pnl_days.description: The days in the export file's pnl section, the wallet's sports and esports realized P&L by UTC day: the file's export_metadata.pnl_rows, at most its earliest 3650 days. 0 while source_range.pnl_series_status is pending, and 0 with it ready for a wallet that traded no sports or esports market.

exported_markets.description: The wallet's sports and esports markets: the rows of the export's markets section, before its 50,000-row cap.

estimated_trade_rows.description: Estimated trades in the wallet's sports and esports markets: the summed trade counts of those markets. The file counts its own rows in generation.source_watermarks.trades.rows.

estimated_size_mb.description: Estimated file size from estimated_trade_rows and exported_markets.

status.description: queued: waiting for a worker. A running job reads queued again, with error saying why, when its worker restarts for a deploy (the next worker claims it within seconds) or stops without handing it back (requeued within a minute of its 30-minute lease lapsing); it starts again from the beginning. running: the worker is streaming rows. reconcile_required: the upload finished but the storage completion answer was lost; the reconciler reads the object back within a minute, retries a failed readback an hour later, and moves the job to ready or failed, and expires_at bounds the wait. ready: downloadable until expires_at. failed: terminal; error says why; submit a new export. expired: the retention window passed; the file is retired, the download route answers 410, submit a new export. cancel_requested: the owner cancelled a running job (POST /api/v1/trader/{address}/export/cancel); the worker stops at its next safe point and the job reads cancelled. cancelled: terminal; the owner cancelled the job and no file was published; submit a new export. A job that has not reached ready by expires_at reads failed with error 'export expired before completion'. failed, cancelled and expired rows stay readable for 48 hours, then the job answers 404.

total_trades.description: Trade rows the file holds: trades in the wallet's sports and esports markets, counted in the file's own read snapshot. Null until the worker has read the snapshot (queued, and early in running); a job accepted before 2026-10-22 can carry the earlier all-markets estimate until its file is read.

processed_trades.description: Trade rows written so far; equals total_trades once the file is read.

terminal.description: True when status never changes again (ready, failed, expired, cancelled). Stop polling.

next_action.description: What to do next: poll the status route after poll_after_s, follow the download route, or submit a new export. Published beside status so a status value added later does not strand a client.

poll_after_s.description: Seconds to wait before polling again. Absent when terminal. 5 while queued, running or cancel_requested; 300 while reconcile_required, the cadence that state can change at.

started_at.description: When the worker last claimed the job; null while queued.

ready_at.description: When the file became downloadable. null before ready, and on jobs finalized before this field existed.

expires_at.description: The retention window: 24 hours from submit. A ready file downloads until this instant; a job that has not reached ready by it fails. A reused job (200 on submit) keeps its original window.

expired_at.description: When the job became expired; null until then.

data_as_of.description: What the file is a snapshot of: the trader's served-data clock (the latest position refresh, else the last completed sync) when the file was written; the same value as export_metadata.data_as_of inside the file. null until the file is written, or when the trader had neither. Read this, not ready_at, to decide whether a reused job is fresh enough; submit with fresh=true for a newer snapshot.

cancel_requested_at.description: When the owner asked to cancel the job; null otherwise. Set on every cancelled job, including one cancelled while queued. While status is cancel_requested this is the instant the worker was asked to stop.

cancelled_at.description: When the job reached cancelled; null until then.

attempt.description: Worker claims so far. A claim handed back when its worker restarts for a deploy is not counted, so attempt steps back by one when the job reads queued again for that reason.

max_attempts.description: The job fails when attempt reaches this.

artifact.description: Present only while status is ready: the stored object's identity, so a client can check the download it receives.

artifact_id.description: Stable identity for this completed export artifact; unchanged when a temporary download URL is renewed.

etag.description: The storage ETag of the object.

compressed_size_bytes.description: Bytes on the wire (gzip); file_size is the decompressed size.

manifest.description: Immutable manifest for artifacts generated with manifest support; null on historical artifacts written before this contract.

manifest_version.description: Version of the artifact manifest contract.

format.description: Serialization used for the decompressed content.

schema_version.description: Stable schema identifier for the selected serialization.

coverage.description: Sections represented by the artifact. JSON and NDJSON carry the full envelope and trades; CSV carries trade rows only.

content_size_bytes.description: Exact byte count of the decompressed content stream clients receive.

content_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the decompressed content bytes.

compressed_size_bytes.description: Exact byte count of the gzip-compressed bytes stored by the object provider.

compressed_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the stored gzip bytes; the multipart ETag is not used as this checksum.

id.description: Opaque generation identity selected for the coherent read snapshot.

product_scope.description: The markets the file's trades and markets sections hold: sports and esports markets only (export_metadata.scope_note in a JSON or NDJSON file names the sections that still cover every market). Absent on a file written before 2026-10-22, which holds every market; a submit never reuses such a file.

coverage.description: sports_esports_rows: the file holds every stored trade in the wallet's sports and esports markets. all_matching_rows on a file written before 2026-10-22, which holds every market's trades.

rows.description: Trade rows the file holds, counted in the same read snapshot as the rows.

v1_async.description: Programmatic API-key-gated export routes (submit/status/download/cancel) and supported formats (json, ndjson, csv).

submit_route.description: POST route template to submit an export job. fresh=true asks for a snapshot read after the submit instead of reusing a finished one.

status_route.description: GET route template to poll job status.

download_route.description: GET route template that 302-redirects to the file.

cancel_route.description: POST route template to cancel a queued or running job.

retention.description: How long a finished export is retained before expiry.

limit.description: The per-minute window's limit for the caller's plan: 100 requests on Pro, 200 on Max. The same number RateLimit-Limit reports on a counted request.

daily_usage.description: UTC-day usage count. Current V1 has no daily hard cap, so limit and remaining are null rather than synthesized.

used.description: Admitted requests so far this UTC calendar month.

limit.description: Requests the account's plan includes per UTC calendar month: 500,000 for Pro, 2,000,000 for Max.

reset_at.description: Unix seconds: the first instant of the next UTC calendar month.

enforced_from.description: Unix seconds: from when request limit + 1 is refused for an account the quota binds.

binding.description: Whether requests over this account's ceiling are refused right now: false before enforced_from and for an admin account.

pay_as_you_go.description: Pay as you go is on: requests over the quota keep answering and bill on a monthly invoice, up to ceiling.

ceiling.description: The most requests this account is admitted in a UTC calendar month once enforcement has begun: limit, or four times limit with pay as you go on (2,000,000 for Pro). null for an admin account, which no number stops. Additive since 2026-09-22.

unavailable_reason.description: Why pay as you go is unavailable, or null. usage_price_reconciliation_required: the account's usage subscription carries a historical price whose included requests differ from its plan's, so pay as you go stays off (pay_as_you_go false) until billing reconciles it. Always sent since 2026-10-17.

monthly_quota.description: The monthly request quota (#16111): where the account stands against the requests the current Pro or Max plan includes per UTC calendar month. Reading it here spends nothing. null only when the month's count could not be read for this response.

id.description: Composite prefixed ID `pos_<wallet>:<condition_id>:<outcome_index>`.

total_size_usd.description: Provider currentValue in USD for the outcome named by outcome_label / token_id, and for that outcome only. An absent key means the provider supplied no value for this leg, not a zero position. combined_value_usd carries the wallet's whole-market total.

position_unrealized_pnl.description: Provider unrealized mark-to-market P&L (Polymarket cashPnl) for that same one outcome. An absent key means unavailable, not break-even.

combined_value_usd.description: The wallet's currentValue across every outcome it holds in this market. Equals total_size_usd unless is_two_sided is true, and is the value the feed ranked this row by.

combined_unrealized_pnl.description: The wallet's unrealized P&L across every outcome it holds in this market. Equals position_unrealized_pnl unless is_two_sided is true.

is_two_sided.description: Whether the wallet holds shares on both outcomes of this market.

holdings.description: Every outcome the wallet holds, primary first. holdings[0] restates the top-level per-outcome fields; a further entry is a leg those fields do not describe. No amount here is a share-proportional slice of a both-sides total.

outcome_label.description: The market's label for this outcome.

token_id.description: Polymarket CLOB token id for this outcome; null for an unsynced market.

avg_entry_price.description: Provider average entry price for this outcome.

current_price.description: Provider mark price for this outcome.

value_usd.description: Provider currentValue for this outcome. An absent key means unavailable, not zero.

unrealized_pnl.description: Provider unrealized P&L for this outcome. An absent key means unavailable, not break-even.

share_count.description: Live share count for this position.

current_price.description: Latest provider mark price for the position's token.

outcome_label.description: Backend-resolved outcome label (provider outcome, else Yes/No from the binary index).

token_id.description: The Polymarket CLOB token id (ERC1155 asset id, decimal string) for this outcome; null when unavailable (e.g. unsynced markets).

event_leg_count.description: Legs collapsed into this representative row for one (wallet, event, outcome side) group. 1 means standalone.

event_total_value_usd.description: Sum of the collapsed sibling legs' own holding values for this (wallet, event) group; equals total_size_usd when event_leg_count = 1, and omitted when any member's value is unknown.

id.description: Prefixed ID (`trd_...`).

win_rate.description: Sports and esports win rate as a ratio from 0 to 1 (0.62 means 62%): wins over the decided sports and esports markets on the wallet's record, the same figure as pnl.in_scope.win_rate on GET /api/v1/trader/{address}. Since 2026-10-27 it no longer counts other markets (#29953). Absent when the wallet has no record or no decided market.

pnl.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was Polymarket's net total P&L over every Polymarket market of the wallet, and wallet figures cover sports and esports markets only (#29953). Read trader.in_scope_realized_pnl.

in_scope_realized_pnl.description: The wallet's realized P&L in USD on sports and esports markets, the figure the 0xinsider profile shows: the record behind pnl.in_scope.realized_pnl on GET /api/v1/trader/{address}, to cents. Distinct from this position's position_unrealized_pnl. For a graded wallet it is read from the latest grading pass, so it can trail that figure until the next pass. Omitted until 0xinsider has computed the wallet's record (#29953).

markets_traded.description: Sports and esports markets on the wallet's record, pnl.in_scope.markets on GET /api/v1/trader/{address}. Since 2026-10-27 it no longer counts other markets (#29953). Absent when the wallet has no record.

id.description: Prefixed ID (`mkt_...`).
Prefixed trader ID (`trd_...`).

rank.description: 1-based rank within the full ranked set (stable across pages).

platform.description: Real provider platform; surfaced, never coerced. Polymarket only.

trending_pnl_usd.description: Polymarket weekly/monthly P&L for the wallet in USD, taken from Polymarket's canonical leaderboard (data-api.polymarket.com/v2/leaderboard?time_period=week|month&sort_by=PNL). This is the ranking axis and the rows are returned in Polymarket's by-PNL order; it is the provider's number, not a locally summed realized-leaf total.

window_volume_usd.description: Both-sides cash volume over the window in USD, from Polymarket GET /v2/user-volume (volume_usdc). Omitted when Polymarket served no volume for the wallet: an absent observation, never zero. Polymarket tracks volume in whole UTC days, so this window is the whole-day span covering the requested one, which is not the exact span trending_pnl_usd was scored over.

window_volume_shares.description: Both-sides traded volume over the window in SHARES, from the Polymarket leaderboard row, whose own schema states the figure is never USD. Omitted when the row carried none.

window_trade_days.description: Distinct in-window UTC trade days from our trades (0 if the winner is not in our DB).

grade.description: All-time trader grade; a separate axis from streak_tier. Led by realized profit on sports and esports markets (the money actually banked, about 95 percent of the grade; since 2026-10-22, the sports and esports share of the wallet's realized P&L), with forecasting calibration, risk-adjusted returns, and consistency as the tie-breaker and proven-trader guardrails: any grade above C requires verified net-positive realized profit on those markets, and the top grades also require a real track record of resolved sports and esports markets plus a survivable drawdown. Relative, so it drifts as the cohort moves. Omitted when the trader is Unranked (fewer than 5 markets, or too little verified record to cohort-rank).

streak_tier.description: Hot-streak tier (trailing-7d cross-sectional percentile). Omitted when there is no recent activity.

in_scope_realized_pnl.description: Additive (#29971): the wallet's sports and esports realized P&L in USD, the same figure as pnl.in_scope.realized_pnl on GET /api/v1/trader/{address} and the 0xinsider profile's Sports P&L, as of the board's last rebuild. Context only: it does not affect the ranking, which follows trending_pnl_usd. Omitted when the wallet is not in the 0xinsider database or has no sports and esports record yet: absent means not computed, never zero.

all_time_pnl_usd.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was Polymarket's net total P&L over every Polymarket market of the wallet, and wallet figures cover sports and esports markets only (#29971). Read in_scope_realized_pnl.

pnl_correction.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-27 and never sent. It was the neg-risk conversion correction to the wallet-wide all_time_pnl_usd (#29971). Its sports and esports part is inside in_scope_realized_pnl.

daily_pnl_series.description: The wallet's sports and esports realized P&L on each UTC day of the window, ascending, one point a day, pnl_usd 0 on a day with none: the same in-scope realized day series the trader P&L endpoint serves. Empty while daily_pnl_series_status is pending, which never means zero. It leaves out non-sports markets, so it does not sum to trending_pnl_usd, which is Polymarket's leaderboard figure across all markets.

daily_pnl_series_status.description: `ready` when daily_pnl_series is served; an all-zero one is a wallet with no sports or esports P&L in the window. `pending` when the wallet's sports and esports record does not carry its daily series yet, or the wallet is not in the 0xinsider database: daily_pnl_series is empty and never means zero. Retry later.

game.description: The game, by the same name every holder chip carries in category_win_rate_game: LoL, CS2, Dota 2, Valorant, Call of Duty, Honor of Kings, Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, Overwatch, Rainbow Six Siege, Rocket League or StarCraft II. Match a chip to this row by string equality.

series_slug.description: The Polymarket series slug the record is keyed on: league-of-legends, counter-strike, dota-2, valorant, call-of-duty, honor-of-kings, mobile-legends-bang-bang, overwatch, rainbow-six-siege, rocket-league or starcraft-2. The stable key; game is the label.

wins.description: Markets in this game the wallet closed with a profit.

decided.description: Markets in this game it closed with a profit or a loss. A subset of the parent Esports record's decided: the two are read from the same daily rebuild.

win_rate.description: wins / decided in [0,1], truncated to four decimals. Null when status is not_enough_data.

status.description: The same rule as the parent record: measured when decided cleared min_decided_for_win_rate, not_enough_data when the counts are real but the sample is under the floor. A chip on a market in this game shows this row's rate when it is measured and the Esports bucket's otherwise.

id.description: Prefixed trader id (trd_<wallet>).

status.description: graded has a proven grade; ungraded is a proven null grade; unknown has no valid historical observation.

grade.description: Grade only when status is graded; null otherwise.

available_from.description: First proven visibility instant for this trader. Null when no observation exists. Earlier times remain unknown.

observation.description: Proof row when status is graded or ungraded. Null when history is unknown.

id.description: Immutable grade_forward_history observation id.

previous_observation_id.description: Previous immutable observation id when retained. A later grade change supersedes that observation but never erases it; this link does not assert why the grade changed.

observed_at.description: Lower bound: the grade writer had started the transition at this instant.

published_by.description: Upper bound: a later snapshot confirmed the observation was committed. This is not an exact commit timestamp.

model_version.description: Writer-proven model family, such as grading. Null when unknown.

model_build_sha.description: Exact writer build SHA when recorded. Null on old and non-model observations.

source_observed_by.description: Database-clock upper bound on when the grading pass read its cohort inputs. Not the event time or source freshness of every input; null when unknown.

category.description: Canonical category bucket, for example Soccer, Esports, Tennis. Esports is one bucket, and the Esports record carries its per-game records in games.

wins.description: Markets in this category the wallet closed with a profit.

decided.description: Markets it closed with a profit or a loss. A market that resolved at exactly zero P&L is in neither count, so this is not the wallet's market count in the category.

win_rate.description: wins / decided in [0,1], truncated to four decimals. Null when status is not_enough_data.

status.description: measured: decided cleared min_decided_for_win_rate and win_rate carries the rate. not_enough_data: the counts are real but the sample is under the floor, so no percent is published. A failed read is an error response, never a status value.

games.description: The wallet's record per esports title, busiest first. Present only on the Esports record, and only when the wallet has a settled market in at least one title; absent on every other category and on an Esports record whose markets are all in series that are not games (skin-price indices, streamer props) or carry no series. Absent means no per-game record, the same rule as an absent category. Each entry's decided is a subset of the Esports record's, read in the same statement from the same daily rebuild.

id.description: Prefixed trader id (trd_<wallet>).

basis.description: Which sample the counts come from: every settled market in the category, at any position size. category_strengths on the trader endpoint reads the floored calibration sample instead, so the two differ in both directions: measured on production 2026-09-22 over the 122,497 wallet-category pairs with at least 20 decided markets on both bases, the floored rate was higher in 56.5% of pairs and lower in 34.5%, median +0.6 points, p10 -4.6, p90 +9.8, with 14.0% of pairs 10 points apart or more. Neither corrects the other.

min_decided_for_win_rate.description: Decided markets a category needs before win_rate is served. Published so a caller can apply its own sample rule to the raw counts.

computed_at.description: When the served records were last rebuilt (RFC3339, Z): the newest stamp among every row served, game rows included, which the daily rebuild writes in one transaction. Null when the wallet has no record at all.

records.description: One entry per canonical category with at least one decided market, ordered by decided descending then category. A category with no decided market is omitted. The Esports entry carries its per-game records in games.

TraderPnl.description: A trader's sports and esports daily P&L object. `id`, `freshness_at`, `series_status` and `realized` are always present. The five sections -- `entries`, `stats`, `monthly`, `year_totals`, `drawdown` -- are present unless the request's `sections` parameter excluded them, so a request that sends no `sections` always carries all five. An excluded section is absent from the object, never null and never an empty array. While `series_status` is `pending` the sections are empty and never mean zero.

id.description: Prefixed trader ID (`trd_...`).

view.description: Representation parameters applied to this body. Present only when the request sent `from`, `to` or `sections`; omitted otherwise, which is what keeps a no-parameter response identical to the one this route served before the parameters existed.

from.description: Inclusive UTC lower bound applied to the daily series; null when the request left the series unbounded below.

to.description: Inclusive UTC upper bound applied to the daily series; null when the request left the series unbounded above.

sections.description: Sections this body carries, in the order the object publishes them, whatever order the query listed.

entries_total.description: Points in the full stored daily series, before the window. Compare with entries_in_window to tell a clipped chart from a wallet that really has that many days.

entries_in_window.description: Points of the daily series inside the window. Equal to entries_total when no bound narrowed it, and reported whether or not entries was among the requested sections.

anchor.description: The last daily point strictly before `from`: the cumulative baseline the window was cut away from. null when the request set no lower bound, or when the window starts at or before the first stored point and the slice already begins at the start of the history. Cumulative values in `entries` and `drawdown` are never rebased to the window, so this is the figure to subtract for a window-relative change.

cumulative_profit.description: Cumulative profit carried into the window; null when the stored point has none, the same nullability entries[].cumulative_profit has.

total_pnl.description: Cumulative total P&L carried into the window; null on the same terms.

drawdown.description: Underwater value at the anchor date; null when that date has no drawdown point, which happens exactly when its cumulative_profit is null. The running peak behind the window is cumulative_profit minus drawdown (drawdown is zero or negative).

freshness_at.description: RFC3339 served-freshness clock: when the wallet's sports and esports record, which this series is read from, was last computed, or, for a wallet that traded no sports or esports market (#30589, #30657) or trades only combos (#30637) and so has no record, its last completed sync; null while series_status is pending. Always present, so read it as a value that can be null rather than a key that can be missing.

series_status.description: `ready` when the series is served; an empty one is a wallet with no sports or esports day, or one that traded no sports or esports market (#30589, #30657) or trades only combos (#30637). `pending` when the wallet's sports and esports record does not carry the daily series yet: every section is empty, realized is null, and the empty sections never mean zero. Retry later.

realized.description: How the daily series adds up to the wallet's Sports P&L, full precision: dated_pnl + undated_pnl = realized_pnl. null while series_status is pending, and for a wallet that traded no sports or esports market or trades only combos, which has no record (#30589, #30657, #30637).

basis.description: The rule behind realized_pnl, the same basis as pnl.in_scope.basis on GET /api/v1/trader/{address}.

realized_pnl.description: The wallet's Sports P&L: pnl.in_scope.realized_pnl on GET /api/v1/trader/{address}. null when the wallet has no published realized figure.

dated_pnl.description: The sum of every day's daily_change over the full history, whatever from/to say.

undated_pnl.description: realized_pnl less dated_pnl. realized_pnl starts from Polymarket's figures under either basis (its sports and esports figures, or its published figure for the whole wallet split by cost) and the days from the per-market record, so undated_pnl holds the wallet's share of Polymarket rebates, the in-scope part of the neg-risk conversion correction, any market with no trade date, and the difference between Polymarket's figure and the per-market record, which on some wallets is most of it. null exactly when realized_pnl is.

entries.description: Sports and esports daily P&L series (oldest-first): one point for each UTC day with realized P&L or sports and esports volume. Present unless the request's `sections` excluded it, and clipped to `from`/`to` when either is set. cumulative_profit and total_pnl are the running sum of daily_change from the start of the history, so a clipped slice keeps the same economic meaning; view.anchor carries the point before the window.

markets_traded.description: Sports and esports markets this wallet traded on this UTC day, counted from the fills 0xinsider stores for it. Omitted on a day whose stored fills include a market outside sports and esports (stored before October 2026), where the count would include it, and on a day above 20 times the wallet's median day.

total_volume.description: Volume in USD this wallet traded on this UTC day in sports and esports markets, buys and sells: each fill's size times its price, fees excluded, the measure of Polymarket user-volume `volume_usdc`, summed from the fills 0xinsider stores for it. A day stored before 2026-10-27 counts the cash each fill moved, fee included, until it is recomputed. Not Polymarket's share count, and not the full-history stats.total_volume on GET /api/v1/trader/{address}, which covers every market. Omitted on a day with realized P&L and no stored sports or esports fill, and, with markets_traded, on a day above 20 times the wallet's median day.

cumulative_profit.description: Running sum of daily_change through this day.

total_pnl.description: The same running sum as cumulative_profit.

daily_change.description: Realized P&L of the wallet's sports and esports markets dated to this UTC day: a settled market on its resolution day, else its last trade day; an open market's realized part on its last trade day. 0 on a day with volume and nothing realized.

stats.description: Pre-derived period stats. Present unless the request's `sections` excluded it. Always the published all/90d/30d/7d windows over the full stored history; `from`/`to` never recompute them over the request's range.

monthly.description: Per-month P&L aggregation. Present unless the request's `sections` excluded it. Whole months over the full stored history, never clipped to `from`/`to`, so a month is never a partial month.

markets_traded.description: The month's entries[].markets_traded summed: a market traded on several days counts once a day. null when a day of the month has total_volume and no markets_traded, a day whose stored fills include a market outside sports and esports, where a sum would undercount. A day with no stored fill, or above 20 times the wallet's median day, adds 0.

year_totals.description: Per-year P&L totals (ascending by year). Present unless the request's `sections` excluded it. Whole years over the full stored history, never clipped to `from`/`to`.

drawdown.description: Underwater (drawdown) series. Present unless the request's `sections` excluded it, and clipped to `from`/`to` when either is set. The running peak behind each point is the full-history peak, so a clipped slice is not rebased; view.anchor.drawdown carries the value at the point before the window.

id.description: The request's id, or null when the request could not be parsed. Omitted on the answer to an unsolicited response message.

ProofPendingPickSlot.description: One PUBLISHED same-day pick whose holder proof is not readable yet: its stable slot rank, the release and kickoff instants, and the instant before which a retry cannot succeed. Every item in `picks` carries its full required shape, so a pick that cannot meet it is listed here instead of being served with missing fields or a synthetic zero.

pick_rank.description: Deprecated compatibility daily release slot; use pick_id for identity and publication_order for scheduling.

kickoff.description: The backed game's frozen kickoff instant; absent for a legacy row without one.

retry_at.description: Recommended next read: 30 seconds ahead while pre-game proof is warming, one hour ahead for a post-kickoff pending legacy row that only settlement can make readable. Schedule against it instead of polling.

pick_id.description: Stable pick row identity as decimal text. Never use a quality rank as identity.

publication_order.description: Compatibility release slot. No quality claim; historic scheduling order is retained.

is_free_selection.description: Viewer-independent free selection designation. New rows store it explicitly; historic null storage uses the original free slot.

supersedes_pick_id.description: Deprecated (#24157): always null. No replacement lineage was ever recorded in this field; the key stays so existing V1 clients keep parsing. Identify a pick by pick_id.

policy_version.description: Identifier for the policy recorded with this authorization. It does not replace the returned max_entry_price or expires_at. Existing grants retain their recorded values.

canonical_event_id.description: Exact provider parent event ID, or provider event ID when no parent exists.

max_entry_price.description: Maximum authorized order price as an exact decimal string, excluding fees. Quote a current executable book for the actual stake and keep the submitted order price at or below this bound. Actual fills may be lower; this limit does not guarantee a fill or define fair probability.

reference_best_ask.description: Selected-token best ask from the recorded reference book at issuance. This is a reference quote, not the authorized order-price limit; use max_entry_price for that limit.

expires_at.description: Authorization expiry timestamp. Existing grants do not extend; an expired authorization cannot authorize a new automated entry.

PotdEntryAuthorization.description: Returned entry permission bound to the named market, token and outcome. Honor the immutable max_entry_price and expires_at, and quote a current executable book for the actual stake. The submitted order price must remain within the returned limit; fills may be lower. Fees are separate, and this grant does not guarantee liquidity, execution or positive expected value.

AgentRegistration.description: A sandbox key and the path to live access (#13959). Nothing is stored: the key cannot be listed or revoked and does not expire. Register again for a new one.

api_key.description: The sandbox key. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <api_key> to the sandbox. The last 8 hex characters are a checksum (the first 4 bytes of SHA-256 over the rest of the key), so the sandbox can tell a mistyped key from a real one. It is not a secret and unlocks no production data.

livemode.description: Always false: this key never reaches live data.

Before integration_key was added, these keys reported oauth_grant.

manifest_version.description: Version of the artifact manifest contract.

content_size_bytes.description: Exact byte count of the decompressed content stream clients receive.

content_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the decompressed content bytes.

compressed_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the stored gzip bytes; the multipart ETag is not used as this checksum.

status.description: queued: waiting for a worker. A running job reads queued again, with error saying why, when its worker restarts for a deploy (the next worker claims it within seconds) or stops without handing it back (requeued within a minute of its 30-minute lease lapsing); it starts again from the beginning. running: the worker is streaming rows. reconcile_required: the upload finished but the storage completion answer was lost; the reconciler reads the object back within a minute, retries a failed readback an hour later, and moves the job to ready or failed, and expires_at bounds the wait. ready: downloadable until expires_at. failed: terminal; error says why; submit a new export. expired: the retention window passed; the file is retired, the download route answers 410, submit a new export. cancel_requested: the owner cancelled a running job (POST /api/v1/trader/{address}/export/cancel); the worker stops at its next safe point and the job reads cancelled. cancelled: terminal; the owner cancelled the job and no file was published; submit a new export. A job that has not reached ready by expires_at reads failed with error 'export expired before completion'. failed, cancelled and expired rows stay readable for 48 hours, then the job answers 404.

terminal.description: True when status never changes again (ready, failed, expired, cancelled). Stop polling.

next_action.description: What to do next: poll the status route after poll_after_s, follow the download route, or submit a new export. Published beside status so a status value added later does not strand a client.

poll_after_s.description: Seconds to wait before polling again. Absent when terminal. 5 while queued, running or cancel_requested; 300 while reconcile_required, the cadence that state can change at.

started_at.description: When the worker last claimed the job; null while queued.

ready_at.description: When the file became downloadable. null before ready, and on jobs finalized before this field existed.

expires_at.description: The retention window: 24 hours from submit. A ready file downloads until this instant; a job that has not reached ready by it fails. A reused job (200 on submit) keeps its original window.

expired_at.description: When the job became expired; null until then.

data_as_of.description: Snapshot selection clock, null until the artifact is written; not provider completeness.

cancel_requested_at.description: When the owner asked to cancel the job; null otherwise. Set on every cancelled job, including one cancelled while queued. While status is cancel_requested this is the instant the worker was asked to stop.

cancelled_at.description: When the job reached cancelled; null until then.

attempt.description: Worker claims so far. A claim handed back when its worker restarts for a deploy is not counted, so attempt steps back by one when the job reads queued again for that reason.

max_attempts.description: The job fails when attempt reaches this.

artifact.description: Present only while status is ready: the stored object's identity, so a client can check the download it receives.

artifact_id.description: Stable identity for this completed export artifact; unchanged when a temporary download URL is renewed.

etag.description: The storage ETag of the object.

compressed_size_bytes.description: Bytes on the wire (gzip); file_size is the decompressed size.

manifest.description: Immutable source, window, replay handoff, count and hashes of both content and gzip bytes.

id.description: wt_<whale_alert_id>; deduplication identity shared with expanded replay.

outcome_index.description: Provider outcome index, null before the canonical outcome trust boundary.

size_usd.description: Exact stored NUMERIC USD notional; decimal string.

PickOfTheDayCommitmentPayloadV1.description: The frozen identity of the pick, exactly as the hash was taken over it. Served byte for byte as it was hashed -- keys sorted by UTF-8 byte value, no insignificant whitespace -- so a verifier concatenates and hashes with nothing to reconstruct. Property order below is the wire order. The outcome is deliberately NOT part of it: surviving a corrected outcome unchanged is the case the commitment exists for. Worked example: {"backed_price":"0.545000","condition_id":"0xabc","kickoff":"2026-09-20T23:05:00Z","pick_date":"2026-09-20","pick_outcome_index":1,"pick_outcome_label":"Lakers","pick_rank":1,"platform":"polymarket"} with the nonce 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f hashes to 44d18fa5e2aa3a2bf3c971dcc9317c8ccbdfd5480a4773b6d8ffd5fbeeea84dc.

backed_price.description: Frozen pre-game price of the backed side, 0..1, as the plain decimal text of the stored NUMERIC at full stored precision, trailing zeros included. A string, never a number: a float round-trip would change the bytes and break the hash. Deliberately not normalized -- 0.545000 stays "0.545000".

condition_id.description: Provider condition id of the backed market.

kickoff.description: Frozen provider kickoff, whole seconds, UTC, literal Z. Fixed precision, never a shortest-lossless rendering.

pick_outcome_index.description: Index of the backed outcome within the market.

pick_outcome_label.description: Frozen display label of the backed outcome.

PickOfTheDayCommitmentPayloadV2.description: Version 2 rank-free canonical payload: sorted nine keys, unchanged string escaping, exact decimal text and whole-second UTC kickoff. pick_id is decimal text; version is JSON integer 2.

backed_price.description: Frozen pre-game price of the backed side, 0..1, as the plain decimal text of the stored NUMERIC at full stored precision, trailing zeros included. A string, never a number: a float round-trip would change the bytes and break the hash. Deliberately not normalized -- 0.545000 stays "0.545000".

TennisPoints.description: Optional current-game tennis facts from API-Tennis, aligned with live_score.scores display order. These facts have their own revision and expiry; Polymarket remains the source of sets, match status, period, and the outer live-score revision. New observations require corroborated identity, current set/games, and live state. Where Polymarket publishes no score (tennis doubles, whose live_score reads one 0-0 set throughout), the group binds on both pairs' names, the tour, the date and API-Tennis's live flag, and carries set_games, the provider's set score for the match. Cached responses and replayed frames may still carry expired facts, so clients must enforce expires_at.

match_key.description: API-Tennis match ID. This is not a Polymarket market or event ID.

player_keys.description: API-Tennis player IDs in the same first/second order as live_score.scores. These are not Polymarket team IDs.

points.description: Current-game point values in first/second order. Read strings, including A for advantage and numeric tiebreak points. Missing points are not zero.

serving_side.description: The serving player in live_score.scores display order. Omitted when API-Tennis does not identify the server.

source_revision.description: Orders only the tennis_points group for the same match. Never compare this with live_score.source_revision.

observed_at.description: When 0xinsider observed these API-Tennis facts. This is not a timestamp from the court.

expires_at.description: Stop displaying the point group at this instant, even if the enclosing score remains fresh. The group expires 30 seconds after observed_at.

set_number.description: Current set number. Display points only while this matches the enclosing scoreboard, unless set_games is present.

games.description: Current-set games in first/second order. Display points only while these match the enclosing scoreboard, unless set_games is present.

set_games.description: API-Tennis games in every listed set, first set first, each in first/second order. Present only when Polymarket publishes no score for the match (tennis doubles): display these as the set score, and discard the group once live_score carries a nonzero game. A deciding match tie-break is listed as games, for example 9-5. Omitted for every other match.

state.description: queued/running are pending consent. verified means the same endpoint revision answered 2xx and activated atomically. failed/cancelled/expired are terminal and do not restart on polling or replay.

outcome.description: Sanitized last observation. Null before an observation; queued retries may retain their previous failure outcome.

expires_at.description: Earlier of the verification-token deadline and 15 minutes after admission. Activation is forbidden at or after this instant.

PickOfTheDayNoEntitledPicks.description: A successful current-day entitlement response when only unauthorized ranks have published. It carries an empty pick set, identity-free locked ranks and an upgrade message. Selection IDs, game identity, prices and unauthorized clocks are absent. Any scheduled or proof-pending rows are entitled rows.

state.description: Only locked ranks are published for this account.

scheduled_picks.description: Rank-ordered entitled selections that have not released. Every row retains release_at and kickoff; unauthorized scheduled ranks appear only in identity-free locked_picks.

supersedes_pick_id.description: Deprecated (#24157): always null. No replacement lineage was ever recorded in this field; the key stays so existing V1 clients keep parsing. Identify a pick by pick_id.

PickLeadBacker.description: Recorded lead wallet facts on a full response when available. Position and category history are frozen at publication; they are not live balances or pick win probabilities.

category.description: Canonical sport of the recorded directional history.

position_usd.description: Provider-reported position value on the backed outcome at publication, in USD. It is the gross value on that outcome and does not subtract shares the wallet held on the other outcome; see net_position_usd. It is not the entry cost or a live balance.

net_position_usd.description: Net value of the lead's position toward the backed outcome at publication, in USD: shares held on the backed outcome minus shares held on the other outcome of the same market, valued at the backed outcome's provider price at publication. Present only when the wallet also held the other outcome; absent for a one-sided position, whose net equals position_usd. It is not a live balance.

position_observed_at.description: Start time of the provider position fetch used at publication. This conservative observation clock precedes completion; the position is not a live balance.

directional_event_count.description: Distinct directional events in the recorded category history.

profitable_event_count.description: Events with strictly positive native terminal P&L in the same frozen category sample as directional_event_count, realized_pnl_usd and roi. Multiple market positions in one event contribute one combined event result. Zero-profit events remain in directional_event_count but do not increase this count. This is a recorded wallet result, not a market win rate or the pick's win probability.

max_realized_drawdown_usd.description: Peak-to-trough realized P&L drawdown after each event result in the recorded sample, in USD. Excludes intragame, unrealized, and account equity drawdown.

recorded_at.description: Timestamp when the directional history evidence was recorded, separate from the provider position snapshot clock.

In the future at SNAPSHOT time and within the requested horizon; because the response is served from a shared snapshot cached up to the ~180s TTL, a served kickoff can be up to ~180s in the past relative to the response time. a_count.description: A-grade graded holders on the piled side.

smart_score.description: Canonical sharp-money score (yes_usd - no_usd)/(yes_usd + no_usd) in [-1, 1] (piled-yes positive, piled-no negative). Deprecated (#16310): `side_share` is the canonical spelling and carries the same value; this key stays on the wire.

volume.description: Cumulative provider taker volume in shares, not cash or dollars.

net_side.description: Aggregate recent flow direction on the market; null when unavailable.

conviction_score.description: Recorded conviction score; higher values indicate stronger conviction.

one_way_holder_count.description: Piled-side graded holders read one-way: their fresh open legs across the signal game's markets (cross-market within the one game; moneyline+spread family only) all back the same team, or, when the market's holder scan was complete, Polymarket's currentValue shows no opposite leg on this market worth 10% of the backed leg and no fresh leg opposes it. Null when the directional read was not computed (no groupable game, no holder-level data on this ranking path, or the enrichment read failed) or classified nobody.

hedged_holder_count.description: Piled-side graded holders classified HEDGED across the game by fresh legs (they back two or more distinct teams). A wallet long both outcomes of this market is not one-way and not counted here. Null when the directional read was not computed or classified nobody.

one_way_graded_usd.description: Piled-side graded USD held by one-way wallets (share-weighted allocation of backed_sharp_usd). Null when the directional read was not computed or classified nobody.

directional_confidence.description: One-way fraction of the piled graded dollars, in [0, 1] -- the metric orthogonal to sharp_pct. Stale, unknown, hedged, and two-sided dollars dilute it toward zero (conservative). Null when the directional read was not computed or classified nobody.

directional_rank_score.description: Recorded side ordering score; higher values sort first.

market_context.description: Required nullable frozen metadata context. Null only during the legacy-generation transition; selected reads require sidecar readiness and fail closed with 503 instead.

EdgeHunterCategorySkill.description: Category evidence over the full uncapped piled-side S/A/B holder allocation. It never changes signal membership, ordering, routing, or sizing.

EdgeHunterObservation.description: One explicitly observation-only holder-pile measurement. It is evidence for cohort evaluation, not an execution instruction, and is isolated from the funded Edge Hunter signals view.

side.description: The side profitable wallets hold, as a provider-backed display label. Canonical spelling of piled_side (#16310), same value: when provider group context is unavailable it may remain a bare Yes/No/Over/Under, so do not use it alone as participant identity.

backing_score.description: Recorded side backing score; higher values indicate stronger backing.

side_share.description: Signed share of graded money on the side, in [-1, 1]. Canonical spelling of smart_score (#16309, #16310), same value.

Filter on most_held to keep the most-held selection. most_held_48h: every row of an admission=most_held_48h response, which is that opt-in selection (up to 8 markets per sport within 48 hours, most graded holders first, recomputed every refresh), including a market a default place also evaluates; it never appears on a default response.

piled_side.description: Nullable provider-backed piled-outcome display label. When provider group context is unavailable, it may remain a bare Yes/No/Over/Under; do not use it alone as participant identity. Deprecated (#16310): `side` is the canonical spelling and carries the same value; this key stays on the wire.

piled_outcome_index.description: Provider binary-column selector: 0 selects outcome_yes/token_id_yes; 1 selects outcome_no/token_id_no. It does not identify home/away or a participant. Use piled_side together with title/event context for display.

smart_score.description: Canonical signed holder-pile score. Deprecated (#16310): `side_share` is the canonical spelling and carries the same value; this key stays on the wire.

volume.description: Cumulative provider taker volume in shares, not cash or dollars.

conviction_score.description: Recorded conviction score; higher values indicate stronger conviction.
